npc.overview: Comprehensive NPC AI system with utility-based decision making, behavior trees (instructions with sensors/actions/motions), A* pathfinding, Craig Reynolds steering, expression evaluation, and JSON-driven configuration.

core_components.overview: Core components are the behavioral building blocks that compose NPC instructions. They fall into five hierarchies rooted in AnnotatedComponentBase: Actions (things NPCs do), Sensors (things NPCs perceive), BodyMotions (body movement behaviors), HeadMotions (head orientation behaviors), and EntityFilters (criteria for selecting/filtering entities). There are also WeightedActions for probabilistic selection. Each concrete type has a corresponding Builder* class for JSON deserialization. There are 327 total Java files in corecomponents (162 non-builder types, 165 builder types).

patterns.builder_pattern: Every concrete component type has a corresponding Builder* class. Builders extend BuilderBase and implement readConfig(JsonElement) to parse JSON, then build(BuilderSupport) to create runtime instances.
patterns.once_trigger_pattern: Both ActionBase and SensorBase support a 'once' flag. When set, the component only fires once until clearOnce() is called at the start of each tick cycle.
patterns.entity_filter_cost_ordering: IEntityFilter implementations declare a cost() value. Filters are sorted ascending by cost before evaluation, enabling early-out: cheap checks (NPCGroup = MINIMAL 0) run before expensive checks (LineOfSight = EXTREME 400).
patterns.info_provider_chain: Sensors produce InfoProvider objects carrying position data, parameter providers, and extra info. These are passed to actions so they know where/what the sensor detected.

state_transitions.overview: State transitions define actions that execute when an NPC changes from one behavioral state to another. Transitions are stored as a map from (fromState, toState) edge pairs to prioritised action lists.

state_transitions.mechanism: When setState() is called with a different state, StateTransitionController looks up the (from, to) edge. If found, runningActions is set. On subsequent ticks, runTransitionActions() executes the action list. Normal instruction evaluation is deferred while isRunningTransitionActions() is true.

root_package.overview: The root npc package contains the plugin entry point and the AllNPCsLoadedEvent. NPCPlugin is the central registration hub — it registers all ECS component types, resource types, systems, asset stores, commands, event handlers, and the builder factory system that maps JSON type names to Java builder classes.

types.name: NPCPlugin
types.purpose: Central plugin entry point. Registers all NPC ECS systems (~25 systems), component types (~12 types), resource types (~6 types), asset stores (AttitudeGroup, ItemAttitudeGroup, BalanceAsset, Condition), commands (NPCCommand), interactions (UseNPC, ContextualUseNPC, SpawnNPC), and the builder factory system with ~100 named builder registrations for Actions, Sensors, BodyMotions, HeadMotions, Instructions, EntityFilters, EntityPrioritisers, and MotionControllers.

types.name: AllNPCsLoadedEvent

entities.overview: The entities sub-package contains NPCEntity (the core NPC component on every NPC) and PathManager (manages path-following state). NPCEntity extends LivingEntity and implements INonPlayerCharacter.

types.name: NPCEntity
types.purpose: Core component attached to every NPC entity. Holds the Role reference, spawn information (role name/index, spawn role, environment, spawn configuration, spawn instant), leash position/heading/pitch, hover state, damage data, blackboard views (BlockTypeView, BlockEventView, EntityEventView), alarm store, path manager, despawn state, reserved-by set, and model scale. Has serialization via BuilderCodec.

types.name: PathManager
types.purpose: Manages the NPC's current path. Can hold either a prefab path (UUID-referenced) or a transient path. Serializes currentPathHint UUID.

asset_config.overview: The asset/builder sub-package (~165 types) implements a JSON-driven builder/factory system for NPC configuration. NPC roles are defined in JSON files under Server/NPC/Roles/*.json. The BuilderManager loads these files and uses a factory pattern to instantiate builders of specific types (Role, Action, Sensor, BodyMotion, HeadMotion, Instruction, etc.). The builder sub-packages include: expression evaluators for dynamic JSON values, holder types for validated field storage, provider evaluators for feature/parameter resolution, validators for asset validation at load time, and utility classes.

key_types.name: BuilderManager
key_types.purpose: Manages loading/unloading of NPC role JSON assets from asset packs. Maintains categories (Role, Action, Sensor, etc.) and the factory registry.

key_types.name: Builder
key_types.purpose: Base interface/class for all NPC builders. A builder reads JSON and produces a runtime object (Role, Action, Sensor, etc.).

key_types.name: BuilderInfo
key_types.purpose: Metadata about a loaded NPC builder (name, index, validation state, etc.).

key_types.name: BuilderFactory
key_types.purpose: Factory for creating builders from JSON type discriminators.

key_types.name: BuilderSupport
key_types.purpose: Support context passed to builders during construction, providing access to the builder manager and expression compiler.

key_types.purpose: Describes a builder type's schema for documentation/validation generation.

key_types.name: StateMappingHelper
key_types.purpose: Maps state names to indices for the state machine system.

key_types.name: BuilderCombatConfig
key_types.purpose: Builder for NPC combat configuration (attack interactions, damage, etc.).

movement.overview: The movement sub-package handles NPC locomotion with three motion controller types (Walk, Fly, Dive), steering behaviors (Pursue, Evade, Wander, Rotate, AvoidCollision), and group flocking support. MotionController is the interface; MotionControllerBase provides shared collision/physics logic; specific controllers handle ground walking, flying, and diving/swimming.

controllers.name: MotionController
controllers.purpose: Interface for all motion controllers. Defines probeMove(), waypointDistance(), isValidPosition(), getComponentSelector(), is2D(), getWorldNormal(), requirePreciseMovement(), enableHeadingBlending(), etc.

controllers.name: MotionControllerBase
controllers.purpose: Base implementation with collision detection, movement physics, bounding box management, heading interpolation, speed computation, and step-up/step-down logic.

controllers.name: MotionControllerWalk
controllers.purpose: Ground-based walking controller. Handles gravity, jumping, climbing, step-up over blocks, fluid interaction, ground snapping, and 2D pathfinding (y-axis projected out of search).

controllers.name: MotionControllerFly

controllers.name: MotionControllerDive

controllers.name: BuilderMotionControllerMap
controllers.purpose: Builder for a map of named motion controllers, allowing NPCs to switch between Walk/Fly/Dive modes.

controllers.name: ProbeMoveData

expression_system.overview: A complete expression evaluator with lexer, parser (Shunting-Yard algorithm), AST, and stack-based virtual machine. Used throughout the NPC system for dynamic JSON configuration values (e.g. 'speed * 1.5 + random()'). Supports NUMBER, STRING, BOOLEAN, and array types.

compiler_pipeline.purpose: Tokenizes expression strings into Token enums. Handles identifiers, strings, numbers, and operators.
Shunting-Yard parser that produces parsed tokens in postfix order. Handles operator precedence, brackets, function calls, and tuple construction.
Builds an AST from parsed tokens, performs type checking, constant folding, and generates a list of ExecutionContext.Instruction lambdas.
Stack-based virtual machine that executes Instruction lambdas. Operand stack with NUMBER/STRING/BOOLEAN/ARRAY operands.

scope_system.overview: Scopes provide variable/function bindings for expression evaluation. StdScope is a HashMap-based scope with parent chaining. StdLib is the root scope with constants and built-in functions.

navigation.overview: A* pathfinding implementation with half-block resolution (0.5 unit grid), support for 2D and 3D search, diagonal movement, path optimization, and path smoothing. Uses a node pool for allocation efficiency.

Supports 2D mode (4 or 8 directions) and 3D mode (6 or 26 directions). Path building does direction-change optimization (only keeping corner nodes).

instructions.overview: The instruction system implements a behavior tree. Instructions are the tree nodes, each containing a Sensor (condition), optional child instructions, a BodyMotion, a HeadMotion, and an ActionList. The system evaluates sensors to select which instruction to execute, then runs the corresponding motions and actions.

worldgen.overview: World generation pipeline with zone/biome selection, threshold-based terrain, recursive cave carving, prefab placement, and a staged buffer-based builtin generator (HytaleGenerator) with 77 composable density nodes.

pipeline.description: Chunk generation is orchestrated by ChunkGenerator, which implements IBenchmarkableWorldGen. Generation is submitted as async tasks to a custom ChunkThreadPoolExecutor. Each chunk is processed by ChunkGeneratorExecution.execute(), which runs four populators in sequence: BlockPopulator (terrain fill + layers + covers), CavePopulator (cave carving + cave prefabs), PrefabPopulator (biome prefabs + unique prefabs), and WaterPopulator (fluid submersion).

stages.name: HeightThresholdInterpolator.populate
stages.description: Pre-populates a per-chunk table of CoreDataCacheEntry objects for all blocks in the chunk plus a 5-block radius, computing zone/biome results, interpolated biome counts, and height noise for each column.

stages.name: TintMapping
stages.description: Generates per-column tint colors by sampling biome tint containers over a 4-block interpolation radius.

stages.name: EnvironmentMapping
stages.description: Generates per-column environment IDs from biome EnvironmentContainers.

stages.name: BlockPopulator.populate
stages.description: For each column: iterates Y from highest threshold-dependent height downward, comparing interpolated height thresholds against height noise to place filling blocks. Then applies static layers (fixed Y ranges) and dynamic layers (relative to surface). Finally places cover blocks (grass, flowers, etc.) on top of terrain surfaces.

stages.name: CavePopulator.populate
stages.description: For each zone's cave types, collects entry points using the cave type's IPointGenerator, checks biome masks and height thresholds, then retrieves cached Cave objects. Carves cave geometry via CaveNodeShape.populateChunk() with CaveBlockPriorityModifier active, then pastes cave prefabs.

stages.name: PrefabPopulator.populate
stages.description: Collects biomes from the chunk and surrounding region, collects prefab candidates from each biome's PrefabContainer using grid generators, resolves conflicts via priority-based exclusion (higher priority prefabs remove lower priority overlapping ones), then pastes surviving prefabs and unique prefabs.

stages.name: WaterPopulator.populate
stages.description: For each column, checks biome WaterContainer entries and fills fluid blocks between min/max water heights where blocks are not solid.

biomes.description: Biomes are the primary terrain definition unit. Each zone contains a BiomePatternGenerator that selects biomes using Voronoi-based point generators. There are two biome types: TileBiome (weighted, tile-based selection) and CustomBiome (noise-threshold overlay on top of a parent tile biome). Each biome defines containers for layers, covers, prefabs, tints, environments, water, and fade transitions.

types.name: Biome
types.description: Base class for all biomes. Holds id, name, interpolation settings, heightmap interpreter, heightmap noise, map color, and all container references (CoverContainer, LayerContainer, PrefabContainer, TintContainer, EnvironmentContainer, WaterContainer, FadeContainer).

types.name: TileBiome
types.description: Standard biome selected by weighted map from the zone's BiomePatternGenerator. Has weight and sizeModifier fields.

types.name: CustomBiome
types.description: Overlay biome that replaces a parent TileBiome when noise threshold conditions are met. Contains a CustomBiomeGenerator.

types.name: CustomBiomeGenerator
types.description: Determines if a CustomBiome should generate at a given coordinate using NoiseProperty, IDoubleThreshold, and a biomeMask (IIntCondition) against the parent biome ID. Has priority ordering.

types.name: BiomePatternGenerator
types.description: Per-zone biome selector. Uses IPointGenerator for Voronoi tessellation, an IWeightedMap<TileBiome> for base biome selection, and an array of CustomBiomes for overlay. generateBiomeAt() selects base biome then checks custom biome overrides.

types.name: BiomeInterpolation
types.description: Controls biome blending radius. Default radius is 5 blocks. Can specify per-biome radius overrides via biomeRadii2 map. Default squared radius is 25.

biomes.selection_mechanism: BiomePatternGenerator uses an IPointGenerator (Voronoi point grid) to find the nearest cell center, hashes the coordinate to get a random value, then looks up the TileBiome via IWeightedMap. CustomBiomes are checked in priority order against the parent biome's ID mask and a noise threshold.

terrain.description: Terrain is generated per-column using height threshold interpolation. For each Y level, the system computes an interpolated threshold from all nearby biomes (weighted by count within the interpolation radius) and compares it against the column's interpolated height noise. Blocks are placed where threshold > heightNoise.

types.name: HeightThresholdInterpolator
types.description: Pre-computes a table of CoreDataCacheEntry for 42x42 blocks (32 chunk + 5 radius each side). Populates zone/biome results and interpolated biome counts. Provides getHeightThreshold(seed, x, z, y) which calls ChunkGenerator.generateInterpolatedThreshold.

types.name: InterpolatedBiomeCountList
types.description: Accumulates biome counts and averaged height noise within the interpolation radius. Used to blend terrain between adjacent biomes.

types.name: CoreDataCacheEntry
types.description: Per-column cache entry containing ZoneBiomeResult, interpolated biome count list, height, and height noise. Lazily computed fields (height, biomeCountList, heightNoise).

noise_functions: IHeightThresholdInterpreter - per-biome height threshold curve, provides getThreshold(seed, x, z, y, context) and getContext(seed, x, z)
NoiseProperty - heightmap noise per biome, evaluated at (seed, x, z) to produce the height noise value
FadeContainer - terrain fade at zone borders, blends heightmap noise toward fadeHeightmap based on border distance
terrain.height_generation: ChunkGenerator.generateHeight() iterates from the highest non-zero threshold Y downward. At each Y, it computes the interpolated threshold across all contributing biomes and compares against the interpolated height noise. The first Y where threshold > heightNoise (or threshold == 1.0) becomes the surface height. Below the lowest threshold-dependent Y, all blocks are filled as terrain.

zones.description: Zones are the top-level geographic divisions. Each zone is defined as a record with id, name, discoveryConfig, caveGenerator, biomePatternGenerator, and uniquePrefabContainer. Zone selection uses a mask image (PixelProvider) read through FuzzyZoom/ExactZoom, with colors mapped to zones via ZoneColorMapping. Zone borders are tracked via distance-to-different-pixel calculations.

types.name: Zone
types.description: Record(id, name, discoveryConfig, caveGenerator, biomePatternGenerator, uniquePrefabContainer). Core geographic unit. Inner records: Unique, UniqueCandidate, UniqueEntry.

types.name: ZonePatternProvider
types.description: Immutable template for zone generation. Holds zones array, uniqueZones (UniqueCandidate[]), MaskProvider, ZoneColorMapping, and IPointGenerator. createGenerator(seed) produces a ZonePatternGenerator with resolved unique zone positions.

types.name: ZonePatternGenerator
types.description: Per-seed zone generator. generate(seed, x, z) reads the mask at randomized coordinates, looks up zone by color, and if multiple zones share a color, uses point generator for sub-selection. Returns ZoneGeneratorResult with zone and borderDistance.

types.name: ZonePatternGeneratorCache
types.description: ConcurrentHashMap-based cache of ZonePatternGenerator per seed.

types.name: ZoneGeneratorResult
types.description: Holds the selected Zone and the borderDistance (distance to nearest zone boundary).

types.name: ZoneColorMapping
types.description: Maps RGB color values from the zone mask image to Zone arrays. Int2ObjectMap<Zone[]>.

types.name: ZoneDiscoveryConfig
types.description: Record(display, zone, soundEventId, icon, major, duration, fadeInDuration, fadeOutDuration). UI configuration for zone discovery notifications.

climate.description: The climate system provides an alternative to image-based zone masks. It uses noise functions (continent, temperature, intensity) to sample a ClimateGraph - a precomputed 512x512 Voronoi lookup table that maps temperature/intensity pairs to ClimateTypes. Continent noise drives land/ocean/shore/island classification via flag bits. UniqueClimateGenerator places named zones at specific climate-searched locations.

types.name: ClimateMaskProvider
types.description: Alternative to FuzzyZoom-based MaskProvider. Uses ClimateNoise to generate climate-based zone masks. get(seed, x, y) evaluates noise, looks up ClimateGraph, and returns color with continent flags.

types.name: ClimateNoise
types.description: Holds Grid (cell distance function + point evaluator), continent/temperature/intensity NoiseProperty, and Thresholds. generate() evaluates all three noise channels and looks up the ClimateGraph.

types.name: ClimateGraph
types.description: 512x512 precomputed Voronoi table mapping (temperature, intensity) to ClimateType IDs. Supports hierarchical ClimateTypes (parents and children). Also computes a fade distance map via DistanceTransform for zone border blending.

types.name: ClimateType
types.description: Named climate classification with color (land/shore/ocean/shallowOcean), island variant colors, Voronoi control points (ClimatePoint[]), and hierarchical children. Continent flags: IS_OCEAN, IS_SHORE, IS_ISLAND, IS_MAINLAND.

types.name: ClimatePoint
types.description: Voronoi seed point with temperature, intensity, and modifier (affects cell size).

types.name: ClimateColor
types.description: Color set for a climate type: land, shore, ocean, shallowOcean RGB values.

types.name: ClimateSearch
types.description: Spiral search algorithm for finding positions matching specific climate criteria. Used by UniqueClimateGenerator to place unique zones. Searches in 100-block steps up to 10000-block radius.

types.name: UniqueClimateGenerator
types.description: Places unique zones at climate-searched positions. Each Entry has a zone name, parent, color, radius, origin offset, search distance range, and ClimateSearch.Rule. Unique records store resolved positions as CompletableFuture<Vector2i>.

types.name: DirectGrid
types.description: Passthrough grid that returns input coordinates as-is. Used when no Voronoi jitter is desired.

climate_util_types.name: DistanceTransform
climate_util_types.description: BFS-based distance transform on IntMap. Computes normalized distance from each pixel to the nearest boundary of its region. Used by ClimateGraph for fade maps.

climate_util_types.name: IntMap
climate_util_types.description: 2D integer array with width/height. Used as ClimateGraph lookup table.

climate_util_types.name: DoubleMap
climate_util_types.description: 2D double array with width/height. Used for ClimateGraph fade distance storage.

caves.description: Cave generation uses a recursive node tree model. Each CaveType defines entry parameters (yaw, pitch, depth, point generator, biome mask, block mask, fluid level). Generation starts by placing an entry CaveNodeType with a generated shape, then recursively spawning child nodes based on CaveNodeChildEntry configurations. Each node carves geometry via its CaveNodeShape and can place cave prefabs and cover blocks.

types.name: CaveGenerator
types.description: Entry point for cave generation. generate() creates a Cave, places the entry node, and recursively continues via continueNode(). Manages biome mask checking, child generation with repeat/chance/depth-limiting, and cave prefab placement.

types.name: Cave
types.description: Container for all CaveNodes in a cave instance. Maps chunk indices to CaveNode arrays (sorted by priority). Tracks world bounds. compile() freezes the raw node lists into arrays.

types.name: CaveType
types.description: Top-level cave configuration: entry node type, yaw/pitch/depth ranges, height factors, point generator, biome/block masks, map/height conditions, fixed entry height, fluid level, environment, surfaceLimited, submerge, maximumSize.

types.name: CaveNodeType
types.description: Node type definition: name, prefab container, fillings (weighted block entries), shape generator, height condition, children count bounds, cover entries, priority, environment. Children set post-construction. Inner classes: CaveNodeChildEntry, CaveNodeCoverEntry, CaveNodeCoverType enum (FLOOR/CEILING).

types.name: CaveNodeType.CaveNodeChildEntry
types.description: Child spawning config: weighted types, anchor point, offset, rotation, children limit, repeat range, pitch/yaw modifiers, chance, yaw mode.

types.name: CaveNode
types.description: A generated cave node instance with type, shape, bounds, yaw, pitch, seed offset, and attached CavePrefabs.

types.name: CaveElement
types.description: Common interface for cave geometry elements. Provides getBounds().

types.name: CavePrefab
types.description: A prefab placed within a cave node. Has prefab supplier, rotation, biome/block masks, and world position.

types.name: CavePrefabContainer
types.description: Holds CavePrefabEntry[] for a cave node type. Each entry has weighted prefab suppliers and a CavePrefabConfig.

types.name: CavePrefabPlacement
types.description: CEILING, FLOOR, DEFAULT - determines Y position of cave prefabs within a node.

types.name: CaveYawMode
types.description: NODE (inherit parent yaw), SUM (add prefab rotation), PREFAB (use prefab rotation only).

types.name: CaveBiomeMaskFlags
types.description: Bitfield flags: GENERATE(1), POPULATE(2), CONTINUE(4). Controls whether cave nodes can generate, have geometry carved, or continue branching in a biome.

types.name: CaveBlockPriorityModifier
types.description: Priority modifier for cave carving. Allows cave blocks to override prefab-cave blocks and cave-cover to override cave blocks.

node_shapes.name: CaveNodeShape
node_shapes.description: Core shape interface: getStart/End/Anchor, getBounds, shouldReplace(seed,x,z,y), getFloor/CeilingPosition, populateChunk. Default hasGeometry() returns true.

node_shapes.name: CaveNodeShapeEnum
node_shapes.description: PIPE, CYLINDER, PREFAB, EMPTY_LINE, ELLIPSOID, DISTORTED. Each has a CaveNodeShapeGenerator functional interface.

node_shapes.name: AbstractCaveNodeShape
node_shapes.description: Base implementation of populateChunk() - iterates XZ columns within chunk/shape intersection, checks shouldReplace per Y, applies fillings and covers, handles surface-limited caves.

node_shapes.name: CylinderCaveNodeShape
node_shapes.description: Cylindrical tube along a direction vector. Linearly interpolates radius1->middleRadius->radius2 along the tube. Uses point-on-line projection for shouldReplace.

node_shapes.name: PipeCaveNodeShape
node_shapes.description: Similar to Cylinder but caps extend beyond 0..1 projection range (rounded ends vs truncated). Uses same radius interpolation.

node_shapes.name: EllipsoidCaveNodeShape
node_shapes.description: 3D ellipsoid defined by center (o) and radii (rx, ry, rz). shouldReplace uses normalized distance < threshold.

node_shapes.name: EmptyLineCaveNodeShape
node_shapes.description: Invisible connector - provides start/end points for child node placement but hasGeometry()=false. No blocks are carved.

node_shapes.name: PrefabCaveNodeShape
node_shapes.description: Places a prefab as the cave node shape. populateChunk() pastes the prefab via PrefabPasteUtil. shouldReplace always returns false.

node_shapes.name: TetrahedronCaveNodeShape
node_shapes.description: Deprecated tetrahedron shape using half-plane tests.

node_shapes.name: DistortedCaveNodeShape
node_shapes.description: Wraps a DistortedShape with ShapeDistortion noise. Has its own populateChunk() implementation that uses projection-based floor/ceiling computation.

distorted_shapes.name: DistortedShape
distorted_shapes.description: Advanced shape interface with Factory for creation.

distorted_shapes.name: AbstractDistortedExtrusion
distorted_shapes.description: Extrusion-based shapes with interpolation and height component computation.

distorted_shapes.name: AbstractDistortedBody
distorted_shapes.description: Body shapes with CoordinateRotator for pitch/yaw rotation.

distorted_shapes.name: DistortedCylinderShape
distorted_shapes.description: Cylinder with start/mid/end width and height, interpolated along projection. Height compensation for steep pitch.

distorted_shapes.name: DistortedPipeShape
distorted_shapes.description: Like DistortedCylinder but isValidProjection always true (capped ends with fade).

distorted_shapes.name: DistortedEllipsoidShape
distorted_shapes.description: Rotated ellipsoid with per-axis radius and interpolated quadratic falloff.

distorted_shapes.name: ShapeDistortion
distorted_shapes.description: Three NoiseProperty values: widthNoise, floorNoise, ceilingNoise. Modulate cave dimensions.

distorted_shapes.name: DistortedShapes
distorted_shapes.description: Registry of DistortedShape.Factory: CYLINDER, ELLIPSE, PIPE. Extensible via register().

distorted_shapes.name: CaveNodeShapeUtils
distorted_shapes.description: Utility methods for anchor computation (box, line, sphere, pipe), end radius inheritance, filling block selection, cover height calculation, cover parent validation, and cover invalidation.

structures.description: Structure placement uses PrefabContainers (per-biome) and UniquePrefabContainers (per-zone). Prefabs are placed by PrefabPopulator which collects candidates from grid generators, resolves conflicts by priority, and pastes via PrefabPasteUtil. Unique prefabs have special placement logic with climate-based or zone-center positioning.

types.name: PrefabContainer
types.description: Array of PrefabContainerEntry, each with IWeightedMap<WorldGenPrefabSupplier>, PrefabPatternGenerator, and environment ID.

types.name: PrefabPatternGenerator
types.description: Per-prefab-entry placement config: grid generator, height condition, height threshold interpreter, placement mask, map condition, parent condition, rotations, displacement, category, exclusion radius, flags.

types.name: PrefabCategory
types.description: Record(name, priority). Loaded from PrefabCategories.json. NONE(MIN_VALUE), UNIQUE(MAX_VALUE).

types.name: PrefabPasteUtil
types.description: Core prefab pasting logic with rotation, height-fitting, block mask evaluation, child prefab recursion (max depth 10), and entity spawning.

types.name: PrefabLoadingCache
types.description: ConcurrentHashMap cache of PrefabBuffer instances loaded from disk.

types.name: PrefabStoreRoot
types.description: ASSETS or WORLD_GEN. Determines prefab file resolution path.

types.name: UniquePrefabContainer
types.description: Per-zone unique prefab generation with UniquePrefabGenerator[] and UniquePrefabEntry[] output.

types.name: UniquePrefabGenerator
types.description: Generates placement for unique prefabs using spiral search, biome/height/parent checks, and exclusion radii.

types.name: UniquePrefabConfiguration
types.description: Detailed placement config for unique prefabs with all conditions and placement parameters.

types.name: WorldGenPrefabSupplier
types.description: Lazy prefab loader wrapping path and PrefabLoader with cached IPrefabBuffer and IChunkBounds.

types.name: WorldGenPrefabLoader
types.description: Resolves prefab paths to WorldGenPrefabSupplier arrays across PrefabStoreRoot locations.

chunk_lifecycle.description: Chunk generation is fully asynchronous. ChunkGenerator.generate() submits to a ThreadPoolExecutor. Each worker thread has thread-local ChunkGeneratorResource. Caching is pervasive across all subsystems.

types.name: ChunkGenerator
types.description: Central worldgen coordinator. POOL_SIZE = max(2, ceil(availableProcessors * 0.75)). Caches: generatorCache(50000, 20s), caveGeneratorCache(5000, 30s), uniquePrefabCache(50, 300s).

types.name: ChunkGeneratorResource
types.description: Thread-local pooled resources: 2 Randoms, BlockPriorityChunk, coverArray, cache keys, ResultBuffers, PrefabPasteBuffer, ZoneBiomeResult, ClimateNoise.Buffer, PrefabPopulator, PrefabPathCollector.

types.name: ChunkGeneratorExecution
types.description: Per-chunk execution context with priority-based setBlock/setFluid logic.

types.name: BlockPriorityChunk
types.description: 320*32*32 byte array. Priority levels: NONE(0) through PREFAB(9). FLAG_SUBMERGE(32).

types.name: ChunkThreadPoolExecutor
types.description: Custom executor with shutdown hook.

types.name: ChunkWorkerThreadFactory
types.description: Creates worker threads that initialize ChunkGeneratorResource.

types.name: ChunkWorldgenBenchmark
types.description: Thread-safe prefab/cave node generation counters.

types.name: ValidationUtil
types.description: Validates all prefabs in zones, biomes, and cave nodes can be loaded without errors.

types.name: ZoneBiomeResult
types.description: Mutable holder for zone result, biome, height threshold context, and heightmap noise.

types.name: MaskProvider
types.description: Zone mask accessor wrapping FuzzyZoom. Provides coordinate randomization, pixel lookup, distance-to-boundary, and unique zone generation.

caching_types: CaveGeneratorCache extends ExtendedCoordinateCache - Cave by (CaveType, seed, x, z)
UniquePrefabCache - SizedTimeoutCache for UniquePrefabEntry[] by seed
ZonePatternGeneratorCache - ConcurrentHashMap for ZonePatternGenerator by seed
ExtendedCoordinateCache - coordinate cache with extra key dimension

configuration.description: All worldgen configuration is loaded from JSON via a comprehensive loader subsystem. Entry point is ChunkGeneratorJsonLoader reading World.json.

types.name: WorldGenConfig
types.description: Record(path, name, version). Immutable config path reference.

types.name: SeedStringResource
types.description: Loading context with FileMaskCache, BlockPlacementMaskRegistry, WorldGenConfig, WorldGenPrefabLoader, and unique ID generator.

types.name: WorldGenConstants
types.description: ENVIRONMENT_NOT_SET = Integer.MIN_VALUE.

types.name: BiomeDataSystem
types.description: ECS system ticking at 1 Hz to update player zone/biome info.

Zone config files - biomes, caves, unique prefabs, discovery
Biome config files - all container definitions
Cave config files - types, nodes, shapes

CoverContainer - surface cover blocks with density/height/map conditions

TintContainer - per-column tint color with noise-driven overrides
WaterContainer - water body definitions with min/max Y

FuzzyZoom - adds coordinate randomization on top of ExactZoom

plugin_entry.overview: The HytaleGenerator class extends JavaPlugin and is the entry point for the builtin world generator. During setup(), it registers a HandleProvider (implementing IWorldGenProvider) with the codec key 'HytaleGenerator' on IWorldGenProvider.CODEC. It also registers a ViewportCommand and listens for RemoveWorldEvent to clean up generators. The HandleProvider creates Handle instances (implementing IWorldGen) that bridge server worldgen requests to the builtin ChunkGenerator pipeline.

types.role: JavaPlugin entry point. Manages AssetManager, executor pools, generator caching. createStagedChunkGenerator() builds the full NStagedChunkGenerator pipeline from assets. submitChunkRequest() dispatches generation to a single-threaded mainExecutor with semaphore protection. Falls back to FallbackGenerator on errors. Concurrency is configurable via SettingsAsset (default: all available processors).
key_methods: setup() - registers HandleProvider as IWorldGenProvider, registers ViewportCommand, listens for RemoveWorldEvent
start() - loads executors from SettingsAsset, registers asset reload listener
createStagedChunkGenerator() - builds the full NStagedChunkGenerator from WorldStructureAsset and SettingsAsset
submitChunkRequest() - async chunk generation with semaphore and fallback error handling
getSpawnPositions() - delegates to WorldStructureAsset's spawn position provider

types.role: IWorldGenProvider implementation registered under codec key 'HytaleGenerator'. Configurable JSON fields: 'WorldStructure' (string, required, default 'Default') and 'SeedOverride' (string, optional). Creates Handle instances as IWorldGen.

json_schema.WorldStructure: string (required) - name of the WorldStructureAsset to use
json_schema.SeedOverride: string (optional) - if set, overrides the world seed with hash of this string

types.role: IWorldGen implementation. Bridges server worldgen interface to HytaleGenerator.submitChunkRequest(). Wraps generation arguments into ChunkRequest. getSpawnPoints() delegates to HytaleGenerator.getSpawnPositions() with max 1,000,000 positions. Default fallback spawn at (0, 140, 0).

plugin_entry.registration_flow: HytaleGenerator.setup() -> IWorldGenProvider.CODEC.register('HytaleGenerator', HandleProvider.class, codec) -> server creates HandleProvider from world JSON config -> HandleProvider.getGenerator() returns Handle -> Handle.generate() calls HytaleGenerator.submitChunkRequest()
events_used: RemoveWorldEvent - cleanup generator cache when world is removed
commands_registered: ViewportCommand - allows refreshing chunks in a specified viewport bounds

assets.overview: The asset system (~243 types under assets/) provides a comprehensive JSON-to-runtime-object pipeline. Every aspect of world generation is configurable through JSON assets loaded via Hytale's AssetStore/AssetRegistry system using typed BuilderCodec instances. Assets follow a pattern: each abstract FooAsset defines a CODEC (polymorphic BuilderCodec), a build() method that produces a runtime object, and a cleanUp() method for resource release. The AssetManager coordinates loading all asset types and provides reload support. Assets are organized into 20+ sub-categories covering every generation concept.

asset_types.role: Top-level world configuration. WorldStructureAsset produces WorldStructure containing a BiCarta<Integer> biome map, biome registry, transition distances, and spawn positions. BasicWorldStructureAsset is the standard implementation using BiomeRangeAsset entries for biome mapping.

Per-biome configuration. JSON fields: Terrain (TerrainAsset), FloatingFunctionNodes (DensityAsset[]), Name, MaterialProvider, Props (PropRuntimeAsset[]), EnvironmentProvider, TintProvider. build() produces a SimpleBiome with all configured providers and prop fields.
Terrain shape definition. DensityTerrainAsset wraps a single DensityAsset that produces the terrain Density function for a biome.
JSON serialization layer for the entire density function graph. Each asset type corresponds to a runtime Density node. DensityAsset.CODEC is polymorphic, allowing JSON to specify any density type.
Position-based density evaluation with configurable distance functions and return type processing.
Double2DoubleFunction assets for remapping density/noise values. Used extensively in density nodes, material providers, and pattern evaluations.
Block material selection per voxel. Each provider maps (x,y,z) to a Material (solid block + fluid). SpaceAndDepthMaterialProvider is the most complex, with condition-driven layer stacking.
Boolean spatial patterns used to conditionally apply materials, props, or other generation features at specific voxel positions.
Generate sets of 3D positions for prop placement, spawn points, and density sampling.
Prop (structure/decoration) placement. Props define what to place (blocks, prefabs, entities), how to orient them (Directionality), and how to scan for valid positions (Scanner).
Map positions to prop types. Weighted selection, field-function-driven assignment, and sandwich (layered) assignment strategies.
Supporting asset types for block masks, bounds definitions, noise generation, scanning strategies, and utility types.

settings_asset_schema.CustomConcurrency: int (>= -1, default -1) - number of worker threads (-1 = auto = available processors)
settings_asset_schema.BufferCapacityFactor: double (>= 0.0, default 0.3) - multiplier for buffer pool sizing

assets.asset_loading_pattern: AssetManager registers all asset types via AssetRegistry during construction. Each asset type has a static CODEC (BuilderCodec) that handles JSON deserialization. Assets implement Cleanable for resource release after building runtime objects. AssetManager provides reload support via registerReloadListener().

new_system.overview: The 'newsystem' package (~29 types) implements a staged chunk generation pipeline that replaces the old server.worldgen ChunkGenerator. The architecture centers on NStagedChunkGenerator which processes chunks through a sequence of NStage instances operating on a shared NBufferBundle (a grid-based buffer pool). Each stage reads typed input buffers and writes typed output buffers. Buffers are 8x8x8 voxel tiles organized in a 3D grid. The system supports buffer caching across chunk generations, parallelized stage execution across worker threads, and automatic dependency-based output bounds calculation.
new_system.architecture: NStagedChunkGenerator implements ChunkGenerator interface. For each chunk: (1) creates buffer accesses for all stages, (2) iterates stages sequentially, (3) within each stage, splits buffer tile positions across workers for parallel execution, (4) after all stages, transfers results from buffers to GeneratedChunk (materials, tints, environments, entities, block states) in parallel. Buffer tiles are 8x8x8 voxels. World height is 320 blocks = 40 buffer tiles vertically. Chunks are 32x32 = 4x4 buffer tiles horizontally.

types.role: Core generator. Implements ChunkGenerator. Manages stage pipeline, buffer bundle, worker executor, timing instrumentation. Builder pattern for construction. generate() runs all stages then transfers results to GeneratedChunk. Constants: WORLD_MIN_Y_BUFFER_GRID=0, WORLD_MAX_Y_BUFFER_GRID=40, WORLD_HEIGHT_BUFFER_GRID=40. Output buffer types: Material, Tint, Environment, Entity.
Debug/development tool that refreshes chunk generation for a viewport region. Used by ViewportCommand. Computes affected chunk indices from voxel bounds and asynchronously regenerates each chunk.

Coordinate conversion utilities between voxel grid (world coordinates) and buffer grid (8x8x8 tile indices). Key conversions: voxelGrid <-> bufferGrid using bit shifts (>>3 / <<3). Also creates bounds for chunks, columns, and buffer tiles.

Interface for providing terrain density values at positions. Used by density nodes (TerrainDensity, etc.) to sample the previously-computed terrain density at a given (x,y,z). Connects the terrain stage output to later prop/material stages.

stages.role: Interface for generation stages. Defines: run(Context), getName(), getOutputTypes() -> List<NBufferType>, getInputTypesAndBounds_bufferGrid() -> Map<NBufferType, Bounds3i>. Context holds buffer access map and worker ID.

First stage. Reads WorldStructure's BiCarta<Integer> biome map to resolve biome IDs at each buffer tile position. Output: NCountedPixelBuffer containing biome ID with interpolation weights. Uses per-worker WorldStructure data.

Second stage. Computes distance-to-biome-edge for each buffer position by scanning neighboring biome buffers. Used for biome transition interpolation and distance-based density modulation. Configurable max distance (clamped to 512). Output: BiomeDistanceEntries with per-biome distance data.

Third stage. Evaluates biome terrain density functions across 3D buffer tiles to produce Material output. Uses biome interpolation (weighted average of nearby biome densities across the transition radius). Positive density = solid block, negative/zero = air. Maps through biome's MaterialProvider to select block types. Creates TerrainDensityProvider for downstream stages.

Fourth+ stage (one per runtime index). Places props (trees, structures, decorations) by evaluating biome PropField entries. For each biome's PositionProvider, generates candidate positions within bounds, then applies Assignments to determine what to place. Reads material buffer to check existing terrain, writes updated material + entity buffers. Multiple prop stages execute in sequence ordered by runtime index.
Penultimate stage. Evaluates biome TintProvider at each column position to produce per-column tint color values. Output: NSimplePixelBuffer<Integer> with RGB tint values.
Final stage. Evaluates biome EnvironmentProvider at each voxel to produce per-voxel environment IDs. Output: NVoxelBuffer<Integer> with environment indices.
Test/debug terrain stage implementation. Likely used for development testing of terrain generation in isolation.
Test/debug prop stage implementation. Likely used for development testing of prop placement in isolation.

buffer_system.overview: NBufferBundle manages a pool of typed NBuffer instances organized in a 3D grid. Each buffer type has its own Grid with configurable capacity for recycling. Buffer Access provides thread-safe views into the grid for reading/writing. Buffers are tracked with stage index for cache invalidation.

buffer_types.description: 3D buffer storing values at each voxel within an 8x8x8 tile. SIZE = (8, 8, 8). Used for materials, environments.
2D buffer storing values per horizontal position within a tile. Abstract base for counted and simple variants.
NPixelBuffer that tracks multiple values with weights per pixel. Used for biome interpolation (multiple biomes per column with distance weights).
NPixelBuffer storing a single value per pixel. Used for tint colors, biome distances.
Buffer for entity spawn data. Stores EntityPlacementData entries (position, rotation, entity holder) for later transfer to GeneratedEntityChunk.

buffer_type_metadata.description: Named buffer type with unique index, buffer class, and factory. Identifies buffers in the pipeline.
Extended NBufferType that also tracks the content class (e.g., Material.class, Integer.class) for type-safe access.

views.role: VoxelSpace<T> adapter over buffer access. Translates world voxel coordinates to buffer grid coordinates for reading/writing 3D content.
VoxelSpace<T> adapter for 2D pixel buffers. Maps (x,z) positions to buffer tiles.
Read-only view over entity buffers. Provides forEach iteration over EntityPlacementData entries.

performance.role: Hierarchical timing profiler. Probes nest (createProbe) to track stage and sub-stage durations. Reports at configurable checkpoint chunk counts.
Interface for memory reporting. NBufferBundle implements this to report buffer pool memory usage.

density.overview: The density system (~77 types under density/) implements a composable node graph for evaluating 3D scalar fields. The abstract Density class defines process(Context) -> double. Context carries: position (Vector3d), densityAnchor (for relative positioning), positionsAnchor, switchState (for conditional branching), distanceFromCellWall, terrainDensityProvider (for sampling existing terrain), and distanceToBiomeEdge. Density nodes form a tree/DAG where each node can reference child nodes via setInputs(). The system supports 60+ node types organized into categories: math operations, noise generation, geometric shapes, position-based sampling, coordinate transforms, caching, and terrain interaction.

geometric_shapes.formula: linear gradient along Y axis with configurable range

coordinate_transforms.name: XOverrideDensity
coordinate_transforms.formula: override context.position.x with child density value

coordinate_transforms.name: YOverrideDensity
coordinate_transforms.formula: override context.position.y with child density value

coordinate_transforms.formula: override context.position.z with child density value

coordinate_transforms.name: GradientWarpDensity
coordinate_transforms.formula: warp position using noise gradient before evaluating input

coordinate_transforms.name: FastGradientWarpDensity
coordinate_transforms.formula: warp position using FastNoiseLite domain warp before evaluating input

coordinate_transforms.formula: warp position using VectorProvider before evaluating input

position_based.name: PositionsDensity
position_based.note: Core Voronoi/cell noise. Finds closest and second-closest points within maxDistance, applies DistanceFunction (Euclidean/Manhattan), returns via ReturnType (distance, distance2, cell value, density lookup, etc.)

position_based.name: PositionsHorizontalPinchDensity
position_based.formula: horizontally pinch input toward nearest position points

position_based.name: PositionsPinchDensity
position_based.formula: 3D pinch input toward nearest position points

position_based.name: PositionsTwistDensity
position_based.formula: twist input around nearest position points

caching_and_branching.formula: cache last position+result, skip recalculation on same position

caching_and_branching.formula: cache with configurable cache size and resolution-based position quantization

caching_and_branching.formula: set context.switchState from choice density, then evaluate input

caching_and_branching.name: SwitchStateDensity
caching_and_branching.formula: return value based on current context.switchState matching configured state
