caching_and_branching.formula: sample input at specific Y values and interpolate between samples for optimization

specialized.name: AxisDensity
specialized.formula: distance from 3D axis line through origin, with falloff curve

specialized.name: AngleDensity
specialized.formula: angle between VectorProvider output and reference vector, in degrees

density.composition: Density nodes compose via parent-child references. Each node's process() calls child.process() recursively. The setInputs() method allows post-construction wiring. Assets build the graph by constructing nodes bottom-up, with ImportedDensityAsset and ExportedDensityAsset enabling cross-reference between separately defined density sub-graphs. The PipelineDensityAsset allows sequential density evaluation where each step's output feeds the next. Context is mutable and shared/copied as needed for coordinate transforms.

return_types.name: CellValueReturnType
return_types.formula: evaluate sampleField at closest point position

return_types.name: DensityReturnType
return_types.formula: evaluate choiceDensity at closest point, select from delimited density map by value range, optionally compute distance-from-cell-wall

framework.overview: The framework package (~29 types) provides foundational mathematical utilities, functional interfaces, spatial mapping abstractions (Cartas), and shader (value transformation) primitives used throughout the generation system.

interfaces.role: Abstract 2D spatial map. apply(x, z, workerId) -> R. Also provides allPossibleValues(). Used for biome maps in WorldStructure.
Abstract 3D spatial map. apply(x, y, z, workerId) -> R (nullable). Used for 3D spatial lookups like image-based biome assignment.
Functional interface (double, double) -> double. Used in various math operations.
Functional interface (double, double, double) -> R. Used for 3D coordinate functions.
Interface for value transformation: shade(T current, long seed) -> T. Three overloads with 1, 2, or 3 seed components. Used in biome/material shading.

abstractions.role: TriCarta implementation that maps 3D coordinates to an image (BufferedImage) via noise functions, then looks up RGB -> value mapping. Used for image-based biome/zone assignment.
TriCarta that stacks multiple TriCarta layers. Later layers override earlier ones (null = transparent). Used for overlay biome systems.
BiCarta returning a constant value everywhere. Used as default when no spatial variation is needed.
Shader that always returns a constant value, ignoring input and seed.
Shader with weighted random selection among child shaders. Uses seed for deterministic selection via WeightedMap.
Conditional shader: applies child shader only when predicate matches current value, otherwise passes through unchanged.
Map-based shader: looks up current value in a relation map to select which child shader to apply. Falls back to onMissingKey shader.

math_utilities.role: Static math utilities: min/max (variadic), limit/clamp, distance (2D/3D), smoothMin/smoothMax (polynomial smooth union), wrap, floor/ceil to grid, toNearestInt.
Linear interpolation: linear(value0, value1, weight) with clamped weight [0,1].
Double2DoubleFunction that blends between two child functions with cosine-smoothed transition in a specified position range.

Deterministic position-to-seed hashing using co-prime multiplication. Generates 7 large co-primes from a base seed, then computes seedAt(x,y,z,...) = sum(coord_i * coprime_i) % coprime_6. Supports 2D to 6D coordinate inputs, both integer and double (quantized by resolution).
Generates arrays of large co-prime numbers by multiplying random subsets of sequential primes until exceeding a floor value (10,000,000). Used by SeedGenerator for deterministic hashing.

Multi-layer density combiner for vertical stacking. Each Layer has floor/ceiling limits, padding (smooth fade at edges), and intersection policy (MAX_POLICY or MIN_POLICY with smooth min/max). Used for combining terrain density layers.
Piecewise linear function defined by sorted (input, output) points. Implements Double2DoubleFunction. Linear interpolation between points, constant extrapolation outside range.
Range remapping: normalize(fromMin, fromMax, toMin, toMax, input). normalizeNoise() maps [-1,1] to [0,1].
Seed-deterministic probability: of(chance, seed) returns true with given probability using seeded Random.
Grid region calculator: given chunk coordinates and region size, computes region min/max bounds. Used for spatial partitioning.
Splits a value range into N equal segments for discretization.
Converts continuous values to stepped/quantized values.
Computes the multiplier needed to reach an end value from a start value in N geometric iterations.

root_package.overview: The root hytalegenerator package (~176 types across 20+ sub-packages) contains the runtime generation objects that the asset system builds. These are the concrete implementations that execute during chunk generation. Major categories include: biome system, material system, material providers, patterns, position providers, prop system, data structures, noise fields, scanners, and utility types.

types.role: Interface extending MaterialSource, PropsSource, EnvironmentSource, TintSource. Defines getBiomeName() and getTerrainDensity().
Identical interface to Biome (same signature). Appears to be a parallel hierarchy.
Primary Biome implementation. Holds terrain Density, MaterialProvider<Material>, PropField list, EnvironmentProvider, TintProvider.
Identical to SimpleBiome but implements BiomeType. Parallel hierarchy.
Interface: getMaterialProvider() -> MaterialProvider<Material>
Interface: getPropFields() -> List<PropField>, getAllPropDistributions() -> List<Assignments>
Interface: getEnvironmentProvider() -> EnvironmentProvider
Interface: getTintProvider() -> TintProvider
Immutable record of SolidMaterial + FluidMaterial. Represents a complete voxel material state.
Holds blockId, support, rotation, filler, and optional Holder<ChunkStore>. Cached by MaterialCache.
Holds fluidId and fluidLevel. Cached by MaterialCache.

Thread-safe (ConcurrentHashMap) flyweight cache for Material, SolidMaterial, FluidMaterial. Deduplicates by content hash. Pre-caches common materials: EMPTY_AIR, ROCK_STONE, SOIL_GRASS, SOIL_DIRT, SOIL_MUD, SOIL_NEEDLES, SOIL_GRAVEL, ROCK_QUARTZITE, ROCK_MARBLE, ROCK_SHALE, FLUID_WATER, BEDROCK(Rock_Volcanic).
Set of material IDs for block mask matching.

material_providers.overview: MaterialProvider<T> hierarchy maps 3D positions to materials. 15+ implementations covering constant, depth-based, noise-driven, striped, weighted random, solidity-checking, terrain-density-based, and queue (sequential) strategies.

patterns.overview: Pattern is an abstract boolean spatial evaluator: isInside(Context) -> boolean. 12 implementations provide boolean logic (And, Or, Not), geometric tests (Cuboid, Surface, Ceiling, Wall, Gap), material matching (Material, MaterialSet), offset delegation, and density-field-driven patterns (FieldFunctionPattern).

position_providers.overview: PositionProvider generates 3D positions within bounds. positionsIn(Context) iterates all valid positions, calling a consumer. 14+ implementations covering mesh-based grids (2D/3D), field-function-driven, anchored, bounded, cached, offset, union, sphere, and list-based strategies.

prop_system.overview: The prop system places blocks, prefabs, and entities at generated positions. PropField ties a PositionProvider (where to place) with Assignments (what to place) and a runtime index (execution order). Props define scanning strategies and block/prefab placement logic.

scanners.overview: Scanner defines how props search for valid placement positions. 5 implementations: AreaScanner (3D volume), ColumnLinearScanner (vertical column top-down), ColumnRandomScanner (random Y in column), OriginScanner (single point).

data_structures.overview: Custom data structures optimized for generation: BiCoordinateCache (2D coordinate-keyed caches with hashed and wrapped variants), VoxelSpace (3D array-backed volumes with boolean, null, and windowed variants), WeightedMap (random selection by weight), TieredList, ReusableList, Compressor, CollectionFactory.

noise_fields.overview: Low-level noise implementations: FastNoiseLite (comprehensive noise library with gradient/cellular/simplex/perlin), SimplexNoiseField, CellNoiseField, and base NoiseField/PointField abstractions.

types.role: Runtime world configuration. Holds BiCarta<Integer> biomeMap, Registry<Biome>, biomeTransitionDistance, maxBiomeEdgeDistance, spawn PositionProvider.
Bidirectional ID<->Object registry with auto-incrementing IDs.
Seed wrapper for deterministic generation.
Worker thread indexing system. Creates WorkerIndexer.Id instances for per-worker data isolation. Data<T> provides per-worker storage slots.
Container for cross-referencing exported/imported density values between asset sub-graphs. BaseHeightReference for sharing base height across components.
Block ID matching predicate.
3D coordinate to 1D array index converter.
Noise-based BiCarta implementation.
Array splitting, binary search, and utility methods.
Vector math: bit shift operations, distance-to-line, angle calculations.
CompletableFuture.allOf wrapper that preserves exception information.
Centralized logging with exception formatting.
3D bounding box types for integer and decimal coordinates.
Range and delimiter types for value mapping.
Range-to-value mapping for continuous domains.
Staged conveyor context dependency tracking.
Integer iteration utilities for scanning directions.
Maps positions to environment IDs. Implementations: ConstantEnvironmentProvider, DensityDelimitedEnvironmentProvider.
Maps positions to tint colors. Implementations: ConstantTintProvider, DensityDelimitedTintProvider, NoTintProvider.
Maps positions to 3D vectors. Implementations: ConstantVectorProvider, DensityGradientVectorProvider, CacheVectorProvider.

fields.overview: The fields package (~8 types across fields/, fields/noise/, fields/points/) provides low-level noise generation and point field abstractions used throughout the generator. It includes FastNoiseLite (a comprehensive 3895-line noise library), simplex noise with octave-based fractal summation, cellular noise with domain warping, and jittered point fields for Voronoi-like position generation.

types.role: Comprehensive noise library (3895 lines). Supports NoiseType (OpenSimplex2, Cellular, Perlin, ValueCubic, Value), FractalType (None, FBm, Ridged, PingPong), CellularDistanceFunction (Euclidean, EuclideanSq, Manhattan, Hybrid), CellularReturnType (CellValue, Distance, Distance2, Distance2Add, Distance2Sub, Distance2Mul, Distance2Div), DomainWarpType (OpenSimplex2, OpenSimplex2Reduced, BasicGrid). Also provides pointFor() method for generating jittered cell points used by JitterPointField. Contains Vector2/Vector3 inner classes for domain warp output.
key_methods: getNoise(x, y) / getNoise(x, y, z) - main noise evaluation
pointFor(seed, jitter, x, ...) - jittered cell point generation

types.role: Abstract base for noise evaluation. Defines valueAt() overloads for 1D through 4D sampling. Has configurable scale per axis (scaleX/Y/Z/W). All noise fields divide input coordinates by their scale before evaluation.

Octave-based simplex noise field. Constructor takes seed, octaveAmplitudeMultiplier (default 0.5 = standard persistence), octaveFrequencyMultiplier (default 2.0 = standard lacunarity), numberOfOctaves (default 4). Each octave has a random offset (0-256) for decorrelation. Output is normalized by 1/maxAmplitude. Builder pattern available for construction.

Cellular/Voronoi noise using FastNoiseLite. Two constructors: one with domain warp (warpAmount, warpScale, domainWarpType), one without. Always uses Euclidean distance function, FBm fractal type. Jitter is doubled internally. Supports 1D-4D evaluation; 4D falls through to 3D.

Package-private pure simplex noise implementation. Provides static noise(x,y), noise(x,y,z), noise(x,y,z,w) methods. Uses standard gradient tables (grad3 with 12 gradients, grad4 with 32 gradients) and permutation table (256 entries). Output ranges: 2D scaled by 70, 3D by 32, 4D by 27.

Interface for generating point sets in 1D-3D with both integer and double precision. Defines points3i/2i/1i and points3d/2d/1d with both list-returning and consumer-accepting overloads. Used by position providers to generate candidate placement points.
Abstract base implementing PointProvider. Provides scale settings (scaleX/Y/Z/W). List-returning methods delegate to consumer-accepting abstract methods.

Generates jittered grid points using FastNoiseLite.pointFor(). For each grid cell in the query range, produces one jittered point. Points outside the query bounds are filtered via VectorUtil.isInside(). Scale controls cell size (larger scale = more spread). Supports 1D, 2D, and 3D point generation. Used by Mesh2DPositionProvider and Mesh3DPositionProvider for prop placement positions.

props.overview: The props package (~26 types across props/, props/directionality/, props/entity/, props/filler/, props/prefab/) implements the prop placement system. Each Prop defines a two-phase protocol: scan() evaluates terrain to find valid placements (returning a ScanResult), then place() writes blocks/entities into the voxel space. Props compose via delegation (Queue, Union, Weighted, Offset) and can place simple shapes (Box, Column), density-driven volumes (DensityProp), clustered decorations (ClusterProp), fluid-filled ponds (PondFillerProp), or loaded prefab structures (PrefabProp). Directionality controls rotation based on terrain patterns or random seed.

types.role: Abstract base class. scan(position, materialSpace, workerId) -> ScanResult. place(Context) writes to voxel space. getContextDependency() returns read/write range for buffer bounds calculation. getReadBounds_voxelGrid() and getWriteBounds_voxelGrid() return bounding boxes in voxel coordinates. Context holds ScanResult, VoxelSpace<Material>, EntityContainer, workerId, distanceFromBiomeEdge. static noProp() returns a no-op instance.

Interface with isNegative() method. Negative scan results indicate no valid placement found. NONE static instance always returns negative. Implementations: PositionScanResult (single position), PositionListScanResult (list of positions), RotatedPositionsScanResult (positions with rotations), FillerPropScanResult (fluid fill positions).

Places a solid cuboid of a single material around each valid scan position. Range defines half-extents (x,z symmetric, y from origin upward). Uses Scanner + Pattern for placement validation. Checks write space bounds before placement.

Places a vertical column of blocks at each valid position. Supports 4 rotation variants (0/90/180/270 degrees) via Directionality. Each block can have pre-computed rotated versions (using MaterialCache.getSolidMaterialRotatedY). Uses BlockMask for canPlace/canReplace checks.

Places density-driven 3D shapes. Evaluates a Density function across the bounding range, then for each solid voxel, computes depth-into-floor/ceiling and space metrics to select materials via a MaterialProvider. Uses a BlockMask for placement rules. Most complex block-placing prop type.

Scatters weighted-random child props in a horizontal radius around each scan position. Uses a weightCurve (distance -> density) to control falloff. For each (x,z) in the circular range, picks a random prop from the WeightedMap and places it in a WindowVoxelSpace column. Only allows child props with zero horizontal read/write dependency.
Tries child props in sequence; uses the first one whose scan is not negative. Short-circuits on first match. Used for fallback/priority prop selection.
Scans and places all child props at the same position. Unlike QueueProp, does not short-circuit. Each child's scan result is stored and all children are placed.
Randomly selects one child prop from a WeightedMap using position-seeded Random. Only scans and places the selected prop. Seed is deterministic per position via SeedGenerator.
Delegates to a child prop with a voxel offset applied to the scan position. Adjusts read/write bounds by the offset.
ScanResult holding a single Vector3i position. isNegative() when position is null.
ScanResult holding a List<Vector3i>. isNegative() when list is null or empty.

directionality.overview: Controls prop rotation based on terrain context. Directionality evaluates patterns to determine which PrefabRotation (0/90/180/270) to apply.

types.role: Abstract base. getRotationAt(Pattern.Context) -> PrefabRotation, getGeneralPattern() -> Pattern, getReadRangeWith(Scanner). static noDirectionality() returns null rotation always.
Tests 4 directional patterns (N/S/E/W). Collects all matching directions and randomly picks one using position-seeded Random. Starting direction maps cardinal patterns to rotation values.
Always returns a random rotation (0/90/180/270) using position-seeded random. Pattern must match for any rotation to apply.
Always returns the same fixed rotation. No directional evaluation.
Record of (x, y, z, PrefabRotation). getRelativeTo() composes two rotated positions.
ScanResult holding List<RotatedPosition> for ColumnProp/PrefabProp.
Enum: N, S, E, W, U, D. Used for directionality configuration.

entity.overview: Entity placement data for worldgen-spawned entities.

types.role: Holds offset (Vector3i), rotation (PrefabRotation), entityHolder (Holder<EntityStore>), objectId. Written to NEntityBuffer during prop placement, then transferred to GeneratedEntityChunk. Implements MemInstrument (48 bytes per instance).

filler.overview: Fluid pond filling prop. Implements flood-fill algorithm to find enclosed non-solid volumes and fill them with fluid material.

types.role: Flood-fill pond generator. Scans a bounding box layer-by-layer from bottom. Uses bit-mask flags (TRAVERSED=1, LEAKS=16, SOLID=256, STACKED=4096) to track voxel state. Bottom layer: non-solid blocks touching edges leak. Upper layers: if the block below leaks or the block is at boundary, it leaks. Uses BFS queue (ArrayDeque) to propagate leak state horizontally. Non-leaking, non-solid voxels are filled with material from a MaterialProvider.
ScanResult holding list of Vector3i positions to fill with fluid.

prefab.overview: Prefab structure placement. Loads PrefabBuffer files and stamps them into the voxel space with rotation and molding support.

types.role: Places loaded prefab structures (PrefabBuffer). Uses WeightedMap<List<PrefabBuffer>> for random prefab variant selection. Supports rotation via Directionality, block mask filtering, child prefab composition (recursive PrefabProp children at relative RotatedPositions), and molding (scanner/pattern-based terrain adaptation). Loads entities from prefabs into EntityContainer when loadEntities=true.
Configuration for prefab terrain molding: moldingScanner, moldingPattern, moldingDirection (enum: NONE, UP, DOWN, N/S/E/W), moldChildren flag.
Enum: NONE, UP, DOWN, NORTH, SOUTH, EAST, WEST. Controls which direction a prefab extends/molds to match terrain.
Static utilities for extracting min/max bounds, size, and anchor from PrefabBuffer.PrefabBufferAccessor with rotation support.

patterns.overview: The patterns package (~13 types) implements boolean spatial evaluation. Pattern.matches(Context) -> boolean determines whether a voxel position satisfies a condition. Used by Scanners to validate prop placement, by Directionality to determine rotation, and by material providers for conditional block selection. Each Pattern also declares its readSpace() — the bounding box of neighboring voxels it needs to inspect.

types.role: Abstract base. matches(Context) -> boolean. readSpace() -> SpaceSize declaring required neighbor access. Context holds position (Vector3i) and materialSpace (VoxelSpace<Material>). Static factories: noPattern() (always false), yesPattern() (always true).
All child patterns must match. Short-circuits on first failure. Read space is merge of all children.
At least one child pattern must match. Short-circuits on first success.
Inverts a child pattern.

Detects surfaces (floor/ceiling/wall). Tests originPositions against originPattern (must all match, typically air) and surfacePositions against wallPattern (must all match, typically solid). Configurable radius, gap, and Facing (U/D/E/W/S/N) for multi-directional surface detection. Positions are generated in a circle and rotated to the specified facing.
Matches when the position is air and position+1 (above) matches the ceiling pattern. Used for detecting surfaces from below.

Matches when adjacent horizontal voxel (N/S/E/W direction) matches wallPattern and origin matches originPattern. Supports matchAll (all tested directions must match) or matchAny (first match wins). WallDirection enum: N, S, E, W.

Complex gap detection for cave-like openings. Tests along multiple angles from origin. Checks that a gap exists (air voxels along angle) flanked by anchor (solid) voxels with specified widths. Also checks vertical depth above/below. Uses PositionedPattern records for efficient spatial testing.
Tests that all voxels within a 3D cuboid (min to max offset from position) match a sub-pattern.
Matches when the voxel's blockId and fluidId equal the configured material's IDs.
Matches when the voxel's material ID hash is in a MaterialSet.
Evaluates a Density function at the position and returns true if the value falls within any configured delimiter range (min inclusive, max exclusive).
Evaluates a child pattern at position + offset.

materialproviders.overview: The material providers package (~29 types across materialproviders/, materialproviders/functions/, materialproviders/spaceanddepth/, materialproviders/spaceanddepth/conditions/, materialproviders/spaceanddepth/layers/) maps 3D positions to voxel materials. MaterialProvider.getVoxelTypeAt(Context) returns null to skip (delegation to next provider in a queue) or a value to place. Context carries position, terrain density, depth-into-floor, depth-into-ceiling, space-above-floor, space-below-ceiling, terrain density provider, and distance-to-biome-edge.

types.role: Abstract generic base. getVoxelTypeAt(Context) -> V or null. Context contains positional data and terrain analysis metrics for material selection decisions. static noMaterialProvider() returns ConstantMaterialProvider(null).
Always returns the same configured material (or null).
Tries child providers in sequence. Returns the first non-null result. Used for priority-based material fallback chains.
Position-seeded random selection from a WeightedMap of child providers. noneProbability controls chance of returning null. Deterministic per position via SeedGenerator.
Simple test provider: returns ROCK_STONE for solid (depthIntoFloor > 0) and EMPTY_AIR for air.
Classic grass/dirt/stone layering. Depth 1: grass, depth 2-3: dirt, depth > 3: stone, depth 0: empty.
Routes to solidMaterialProvider when depthIntoFloor > 0, emptyMaterialProvider when not solid.
Returns child provider's value only when depthIntoFloor equals exact configured depth. Otherwise null.
Returns child provider's value only when depthIntoCeiling equals exact configured depth.
Returns child provider's value only when spaceBelowCeiling equals exact configured space.
Returns child provider's value only when spaceAboveFloor equals exact configured space.
Returns child provider's value only when position.y is within [bottomY, topY).
Returns child provider's value when position.y falls within any configured Stripe (topY/bottomY range).
Selects material based on terrain density value (from context.density). Uses FieldDelimiter array with [bottom, top) ranges.

Evaluates a Density function at position, then selects material provider based on density value falling within delimiter ranges. More flexible than TerrainDensityMaterialProvider since it uses an arbitrary density function rather than the pre-computed terrain density.

Most complex material provider. Stacks Layer instances based on either DEPTH_INTO_FLOOR or DEPTH_INTO_CEILING context. Each Layer has a thickness (possibly noise-driven or weighted random) and a MaterialProvider. Condition qualifies the provider (position-dependent). Layers are accumulated in sequence; when cumulative thickness exceeds the position's depth, that layer's material is used. Supports maxDistance cutoff.

spaceanddepth_conditions.role: Interface: qualifies(x, y, z, depthIntoFloor, depthIntoCeiling, spaceAboveFloor, spaceBelowCeiling) -> boolean.
Enum: SPACE_ABOVE_FLOOR, SPACE_BELOW_CEILING. Used by other condition implementations.

spaceanddepth_layers.role: Thickness varies by noise function at position.
Thickness derived from a range of depth/space values.
Randomly selects thickness from weighted options.

functions.role: Functional interface (double x, double z) -> double. Used for horizontal-plane functions.

datastructures.overview: The data structures package (~16 types across datastructures/, datastructures/bicoordinatecache/, datastructures/compression/, datastructures/voxelspace/) provides specialized data structures optimized for world generation. VoxelSpace is the core 3D array abstraction used by all generation stages. WeightedMap provides weighted random selection. TieredList supports priority-ordered element storage. BiCoordinateCache provides position-keyed caching.

types.role: Interface for 3D voxel data access. Methods: set(value, x, y, z), getContent(x, y, z), replace(..., Predicate), pasteFrom(other), setOrigin(), isInsideSpace(), forEach(VoxelConsumer), getBounds(). Defines min/max/size for X/Y/Z axes.
Standard implementation backed by a flat Object array. setOrigin() offsets coordinate access for world-space positioning.
Optimized boolean voxel space.

View adapter that restricts access to a sub-region of a parent VoxelSpace. setWindow(minX, minY, minZ, maxX, maxY, maxZ) updates the visible region. Used by ClusterProp to restrict placement to single columns.
No-op VoxelSpace that always returns null and rejects writes. Singleton via instance().
Functional interface for iterating over voxel data: accept(T content, int x, int y, int z).
Coordinate record for voxel space access.
Static utilities for VoxelSpace operations.

Weighted random selection data structure. add(element, weight) adds entries. pick(Random) selects proportionally. Supports forEach, allElements, makeImmutable. Used throughout for weighted prop selection, material selection, and shader selection.

Priority queue organized by integer tiers. Elements are stored in per-tier ArrayLists. getTiers() returns sorted tier list. forEach/removeEach iterate in tier order. Used for organizing generation stages by priority.
Static utility: hashSetOf(T...) creates a HashSet from varargs with null checking.
Interface for 2D coordinate-keyed caches.
HashMap-based implementation of BiCoordinateCache.
Array-backed fixed-size 2D coordinate cache using coordinate wrapping for fast access.
Specialized double-value variant of WrappedBiCoordinateCache.

Run-length compression for Object arrays. compressOnReference() encodes runs of 7+ identical references as Run objects. decompress() restores the original array. Used for compressing voxel data. MIN_RUN threshold = 7.

positionproviders.overview: The position providers package (~15 types) generates 3D positions within bounding volumes for prop placement. PositionProvider.positionsIn(Context) iterates valid positions and calls context.consumer for each. Context defines minInclusive/maxExclusive bounds and an optional anchor point. Providers compose via delegation, filtering, caching, and union.

types.role: Abstract base. positionsIn(Context) generates positions within bounds. Context: minInclusive, maxExclusive (Vector3d), consumer (Consumer<Vector3d>), anchor (nullable Vector3d). static noPositionProvider() does nothing.

Generates 2D positions on a horizontal plane at fixed Y using a PointProvider (typically JitterPointField). Converts 2D points to 3D by setting Y to configured value. Skips if Y is outside the query bounds.
Generates 3D positions using a PointProvider. Directly delegates points3d() with query bounds.
Offsets query bounds by the context anchor, delegates to child provider, then reverses the offset on output positions. isReversed flag controls offset direction.
Adds baseHeight to all Y coordinates of positions generated by child provider.
Overrides context bounds with fixed Bounds3d, ignoring the incoming bounds.

Probabilistically filters positions from a child provider. Evaluates a Density function at each position; the result (0-1) is the keep probability. Uses position-seeded random for determinism. FP_RESOLUTION = 100.0 for seed quantization.
Filters positions from child provider by density function value. Keeps positions where the density value falls within any configured delimiter range [min, max).
Filters positions from child provider by Y range (RangeDouble).
Filters positions from child provider by distance from origin (position.length() <= range).
Shifts query bounds by -offset, delegates to child, then adds offset to output positions.
Returns a fixed list of pre-defined positions. from3i() and from3d() factory methods. Note: has a bug — bounds check result is not used for filtering.
Concatenates positions from multiple child providers.

Caches generated positions in spatial sections (configurable sectionSize). Uses hash-keyed cache (CacheThreadMemory) with LRU eviction. Section positions are generated once and reused. Reduces redundant computation for overlapping queries.
Cache storage for CachedPositionProvider. HashMap<Long, Vector3d[]> sections with LinkedList<Long> expirationList for LRU eviction.

propdistributions.overview: The prop distributions (assignments) package (~5 types) maps generated positions to specific Prop instances. Assignments.propAt(position, workerId, distanceToBiomeEdge) -> Prop determines what to place at each position. This is the decision layer between 'where to place' (PositionProvider) and 'what to place' (Prop).

types.role: Abstract base. propAt(Vector3d position, WorkerIndexer.Id, double distanceToBiomeEdge) -> Prop. getRuntime() -> int (execution order index for stage sequencing). getAllPossibleProps() for dependency analysis. static noPropDistribution(runtime) returns Prop.noProp() always.
Always returns the same Prop at every position.

Evaluates a Density function at position, then selects child Assignments based on the value falling within FieldDelimiter ranges [bottom, top). Each delimiter maps to its own Assignments instance for recursive composition.
Selects child Assignments based on position.y falling within VerticalDelimiter ranges [minY, maxY). Used for vertical stratification of prop types.
Position-seeded weighted random selection from a WeightedMap<Assignments>. noneProbability controls chance of no placement. Coordinates are quantized (*10000) before seeding for sub-voxel resolution.

scanners.overview: The scanners package (~5 types) provides scanning strategies for finding valid prop placement positions within the voxel space. Scanner.scan(Context) returns a list of valid Vector3i positions. Context carries position, Pattern, VoxelSpace<Material>, and workerId.

types.role: Abstract base. scan(Context) -> List<Vector3i>. scanSpace() -> SpaceSize (bounding range of voxels accessed). readSpaceWith(Pattern) combines pattern's read space with scanner's scan space. static noScanner() returns empty list.
Scans a vertical column top-down or bottom-up within [minY, maxY). Supports relative-to-position or absolute (baseHeight-relative) Y ranges. Returns up to resultsCap positions where pattern matches.

Random vertical scanning with two strategies: DART_THROW (random Y samples with collision avoidance) and PICK_VALID (collect all valid, randomly subset). Uses position-seeded FastRandom for determinism.

Scans a 2D horizontal area (CIRCLE or SQUARE shape) of given range. For each horizontal offset ordered by distance from origin, delegates to a child scanner for vertical scanning. Returns up to resultCap total positions across all columns.
Singleton scanner. Tests only the origin position against the pattern. Returns a single-element list if pattern matches, otherwise empty. Minimal scan space.

biome.overview: The biome package (~8 types) defines the Biome interface hierarchy and implementations. Biome combines MaterialSource, PropsSource, EnvironmentSource, and TintSource into a complete per-biome configuration with a terrain density function.

types.role: Interface extending MaterialSource, PropsSource, EnvironmentSource, TintSource. Defines getBiomeName() and getTerrainDensity() -> Density.
Parallel interface identical to Biome (same methods). Appears to be a legacy/alternative hierarchy.

Primary Biome implementation. Holds: biomeName, terrainDensity, materialProvider, propFields (mutable list, populated via addPropFieldTo), environmentProvider, tintProvider. getAllPropDistributions() extracts Assignments from each PropField.
BiomeType implementation parallel to SimpleBiome. Identical structure without @Nonnull on some methods.
Interface: getMaterialProvider() -> MaterialProvider<Material>.
Interface: getPropFields() -> List<PropField>, getAllPropDistributions() -> List<Assignments>.
Interface: getEnvironmentProvider() -> EnvironmentProvider.
Interface: getTintProvider() -> TintProvider.

biomemap.overview: The biomemap package (~2 types) provides BiCarta-based biome mapping with configurable per-biome-pair transition radii.

types.role: Abstract class extending BiCarta<BiomeType>. Base type for biome spatial mapping.

BiomeMap implementation wrapping a BiCarta<BiomeType>. Adds per-biome-pair transition radius configuration via pairHashToRadius map with defaultTransitionRadius (default 1). apply() delegates to underlying carta.

bounds.overview: The bounds package (~3 types) provides 3D axis-aligned bounding box types for both integer and decimal coordinates.

types.role: Decimal (Vector3d) AABB. Methods: contains(point/bounds), intersects, isZeroVolume, getSize, assign, offset, intersect, encompass (union), stack (combine bounds of nested placement), flipOnOriginPoint/Voxel. Auto-corrects min/max on construction. MemInstrument: 40 bytes.
Integer (Vector3i) AABB. Same API as Bounds3d for integer coordinates. toBounds3d() for conversion. MemInstrument: 28 bytes.

@Deprecated. Wrapper around minInclusive/maxExclusive Vector3i. Provides getRange() (max absolute extent), toBounds3i(), moveBy(delta). Static merge() (union) and stack() (nested placement bounds). Being replaced by Bounds3i.

cartas.overview: The cartas package (~1 type) provides noise-driven spatial mapping.

types.role: BiCarta<T> implementation using a Density function for spatial evaluation. Evaluates density at (x, 0, z), maps the result through a DoubleRangeMap<T> to select a value. Falls back to defaultValue when no range matches. Used for noise-driven biome assignment.

chunkgenerator.overview: The chunkgenerator package (~3 types) defines the ChunkGenerator interface and supporting types.

types.role: Interface: generate(ChunkRequest.Arguments) -> GeneratedChunk, getSpawnPositions() -> PositionProvider. Implemented by NStagedChunkGenerator (Part A).

Record containing GeneratorProfile and Arguments. Arguments: seed, index (long), x, z, stillNeeded (LongPredicate, nullable). GeneratorProfile: worldStructureName, seed, worldCounter. Profile is used as cache key for generator instances.
Singleton ChunkGenerator that produces empty chunks. Used as error fallback when normal generation fails. Returns empty GeneratedBlockChunk, GeneratedBlockStateChunk, GeneratedEntityChunk.

commands.overview: The commands package (~1 type) provides debug/development commands for the generator.

types.role: AbstractPlayerCommand implementation. Creates an NViewport for a specified region (either by radius from player position or by block selection). Supports delete flag to remove active viewport. Registers as an AssetManager reload listener to auto-refresh on asset changes. Radius argument is multiplied by 32 (<<5) to convert chunk radius to voxel radius.

conveyor.overview: The conveyor package (~1 type) provides dependency tracking for the staged generation pipeline.

types.role: Tracks read and write ranges for buffer pipeline stages. readRange and writeRange (Vector3i) define how far each stage reads from and writes to neighboring tiles. Derived fields: trashRange (read+write extent), externalDependencyRange, positioningRange. Y components are zeroed (vertical dependencies handled differently). stackOver() composes two dependencies for chained stages. Key static methods: getRequiredPadOf() sums external dependencies across stages, stackMaps/cloneMap for per-buffer-type dependency maps, mostOf() finds maximum dependency envelope. from(readBounds, writeBounds) constructs from Bounds3i. EMPTY static instance for zero dependency.

delimiters.overview: The delimiters package (~4 types) provides range-value mapping types used for density-based selection throughout the generator.

types.role: Pair of RangeDouble and nullable value V. Used in density-delimited environment/tint providers.
Pair of RangeInt and nullable value V.
Double range with minInclusive and maxExclusive. contains(value) checks [min, max).
Integer range with minInclusive and maxExclusive. contains(value) checks [min, max).

environmentproviders.overview: The environment providers package (~3 types) maps positions to integer environment IDs for weather/lighting zones.

types.role: Abstract base. getValue(Context) -> int. Context holds Vector3i position. static noEnvironmentProvider() returns ConstantEnvironmentProvider(0).
Always returns the same integer value.
Evaluates a Density function at position, then selects child EnvironmentProvider based on density value falling within delimiter ranges. Returns 0 if no range matches.

tintproviders.overview: The tint providers package (~4 types) maps positions to ARGB tint color values applied to terrain blocks.

types.role: Abstract base. getValue(Context) -> Result. Context holds position (Vector3i) and workerId. Result contains tint (int ARGB) and hasValue boolean. DEFAULT_TINT is RGB(91, -98, 40) = a green tone. static noTintProvider() returns constant DEFAULT_TINT. Result.WITHOUT_VALUE static instance for no-tint.
Always returns the same tint value.
Evaluates a Density function, selects child TintProvider based on density value in delimiter ranges. Returns WITHOUT_VALUE if no range matches.
Always returns Result.WITHOUT_VALUE.

vectorproviders.overview: The vector providers package (~4 types) maps positions to 3D vectors, used for density warping and directional effects.

types.role: Abstract base. process(Context, Vector3d vector_out) writes result to vector_out. Context holds position (Vector3d) and terrainDensityProvider. Can be constructed from Density.Context.
Always writes the same constant Vector3d.

Computes the gradient of a Density function at a position by sampling at position and position+sampleDistance on each axis. Output vector is (deltaX, deltaY, deltaZ) representing the density gradient direction.

Caches last position+result pair. If position matches, returns cached vector without re-computing. Note: has a bug — early return in cache hit doesn't prevent re-computation since the cache miss path always runs.

iterators.overview: The iterators package (~3 types) provides directional integer iteration utilities.

types.role: IntIterator that counts upward from min to maxExclusive-1. Cloneable.
IntIterator that counts downward from maxExclusive-1 to min. Cloneable.
Factory: range(start, end) returns ForwardIntIterator if start <= end, BackwardIntIterator otherwise.

material.overview: The material package (~4 types) defines the voxel material system — what blocks/fluids exist at each position.

types.role: Immutable pair of SolidMaterial + FluidMaterial. Lazy-computed hashCode and materialIdsHash. equals() checks both solid and fluid components.
Block material state: blockId, support, rotation, filler (all int), optional Holder<ChunkStore> for ECS section state. Package-private constructor (via MaterialCache).
Fluid material state: fluidId (int), fluidLevel (byte). Package-private constructor (via MaterialCache).

Thread-safe (ConcurrentHashMap) flyweight cache for Material/SolidMaterial/FluidMaterial. Deduplicates by content hash. Pre-creates common materials: EMPTY_AIR, ROCK_STONE, SOIL_GRASS, SOIL_DIRT, SOIL_MUD, SOIL_NEEDLES, SOIL_GRAVEL, ROCK_QUARTZITE, ROCK_MARBLE, ROCK_SHALE, FLUID_WATER, BEDROCK(Rock_Volcanic), UNKNOWN_FLUID, EMPTY_FLUID, EMPTY. getSolidMaterialRotatedY() creates rotation variants. Integrates with BlockType and Fluid asset maps for string-to-ID resolution.

rangemaps.overview: The range maps package (~2 types) provides double-precision range-to-value mapping.

types.role: Double range with configurable inclusive/exclusive min and max. includes(v) checks membership. Static factories: inclusive(min, max), exclusive(min, max).
Ordered list of DoubleRange -> T mappings. get(k) returns first matching value (linear scan). Used by SimpleNoiseCarta for density-to-biome mapping.

referencebundle.overview: The reference bundle package (~3 types) provides a typed string-keyed container for sharing data between asset sub-graphs.

types.role: Empty base class for typed references.
Reference subclass holding a BiDouble2DoubleFunction for base height lookup at (x, z) coordinates.

String-keyed heterogeneous map with type safety. put(name, reference, type) stores with type tag. get(name, type) retrieves with assertion check. Used for cross-referencing exported density values and base heights between asset sub-graphs.

seed.overview: The seed package (~1 type) provides hierarchical seed management.

types.role: Hierarchical seed container. Wraps a String key. child(childKey) creates a new SeedBox with concatenated key. createSupplier() returns a Supplier<Integer> backed by Random seeded with key.hashCode(). Used by material providers and other deterministic random selection points.

threadindexer.overview: The thread indexer package (~1 type) provides per-worker-thread data isolation.

types.role: Creates a fixed set of WorkerIndexer.Id instances (one per worker thread). Data<T> inner class provides per-worker storage slots with lazy initialization. Session inner class provides sequential Id allocation for assigning work to workers. Id has static UNKNOWN (-1) and MAIN (0) constants. Used throughout for thread-safe per-worker context (noise generators, density contexts, etc.).

worldstructure.overview: The world structure package (~1 type) is the top-level runtime world configuration.

types.role: Immutable runtime world config. Contains: biomeMap (BiCarta<Integer> mapping positions to biome IDs), biomeRegistry (Registry<Biome> for ID -> Biome lookup), biomeTransitionDistance (int, controls interpolation radius), maxBiomeEdgeDistance (int, max distance for edge detection), spawnPositions (PositionProvider for player spawn). Built by WorldStructureAsset from JSON configuration.

ecs_integration.description: BiomeDataSystem extends DelayedEntitySystem<EntityStore>, ticks at 1 Hz. Queries entities with (Player, TransformComponent) archetype. Updates WorldMapTracker with current zone/biome data.

references: BlockType.getAssetMap() - cave population, water population, block priority override
Fluid.getAssetMap() - fluid placement for max fluid level

external_libraries: com.google.gson - JSON parsing in all loaders

references: IPointGenerator - Voronoi grids for biomes, caves, prefabs

server_worldgen_interfaces.IWorldGenProvider: HandleProvider implements IWorldGenProvider, registered via IWorldGenProvider.CODEC.register('HytaleGenerator', ...) in HytaleGenerator.setup()
server_worldgen_interfaces.IWorldGen: Handle implements IWorldGen. Bridges server.worldgen.IWorldGen.generate() to the builtin ChunkGenerator pipeline.
server_worldgen_interfaces.GeneratedChunk: NStagedChunkGenerator produces GeneratedChunk with GeneratedBlockChunk, GeneratedBlockStateChunk, GeneratedEntityChunk, and section Holders.
server_worldgen_interfaces.GeneratedBlockChunk: Receives block IDs, rotations, fillers, tint colors, environment data from buffer transfer.
server_worldgen_interfaces.GeneratedBlockStateChunk: Receives Holder<ChunkStore> references for ECS section state from SolidMaterial.holder.
server_worldgen_interfaces.GeneratedEntityChunk: Receives entity spawn data (offset, rotation, entity holder) from NEntityBuffer.

ecs_components.ChunkStore: Used via Holder<ChunkStore> in SolidMaterial for block state management and section references.
ecs_components.FluidSection: NStagedChunkGenerator.transferMaterials() writes fluid data (fluidId, fluidLevel) to FluidSection per chunk section.
ecs_components.BlockPhysics: NStagedChunkGenerator.setSupport() uses BlockPhysics.setSupportValue/reset/clear for block physics state.

events.RemoveWorldEvent: HytaleGenerator listens globally and removes cached generators when worlds are removed.
events.LoadedAssetsEvent: AssetManager uses this to trigger asset loading and reload callbacks.

commands.ViewportCommand: Registered by HytaleGenerator. Uses NViewport to refresh chunk generation in a specified region.

asset_store.AssetRegistry: All asset types register via AssetRegistry. AssetManager coordinates loading.
asset_store.AssetStore: BiomeAsset, SettingsAsset, WorldStructureAsset, and all other assets use AssetStore for lookup by ID.
asset_store.BlockType: MaterialCache resolves block names (e.g., 'Rock_Stone') to block IDs via BlockType.fromString().
asset_store.Fluid: MaterialCache resolves fluid names to fluid IDs and levels via Fluid.getAssetMap().

builtin_a_cross_references.relationship_to_server_worldgen: The builtin hytalegenerator is a complete replacement/reimplementation of the old server.worldgen pipeline. While the server.worldgen package defined zone/biome/container/populator architecture with HeightThresholdInterpolator-based terrain, the builtin uses a density-function-based terrain system with staged buffer processing. The old pipeline used explicit block/cave/prefab/water populators; the new system unifies terrain and prop placement through the staged NStage architecture. The server.worldgen types (Zone, BiomePatternGenerator, etc.) appear to be the legacy system, while this builtin is the active 'new system' (hence the 'newsystem' package name).

density_system_integration.overview: Many types in Part B consume density functions from Part A's density system. FieldFunctionPattern, FieldFunctionMaterialProvider, FieldFunctionPositionProvider, FieldFunctionOccurrencePositionProvider, FieldFunctionAssignments, DensityDelimitedEnvironmentProvider, DensityDelimitedTintProvider, DensityGradientVectorProvider, SimpleNoiseCarta, and DensityProp all evaluate Density.process() for spatial decision-making.
density_system_integration.density_context_flow: Density.Context flows from MaterialProvider.Context (which includes terrainDensityProvider) and from Pattern.Context (position + materialSpace). The terrainDensityProvider links back to the NTerrainStage output from Part A's pipeline.

asset_system_integration.overview: Every runtime type in Part B has a corresponding *Asset class in Part A's asset system that deserializes from JSON and builds the runtime object. For example: PatternAsset builds Pattern, PropAsset builds Prop, MaterialProviderAsset builds MaterialProvider, ScannerAsset builds Scanner, PositionProviderAsset builds PositionProvider, AssignmentsAsset builds Assignments, etc.

pipeline_integration.overview: Part B types are consumed by Part A's NStagedChunkGenerator pipeline stages. NTerrainStage uses Biome.getTerrainDensity() and Biome.getMaterialProvider(). NPropStage uses Biome.getPropFields() which contains PropField (linking PositionProvider and Assignments). NTintStage uses Biome.getTintProvider(). NEnvironmentStage uses Biome.getEnvironmentProvider(). NBufferBundle views (NVoxelBufferView) wrap VoxelSpace<Material> for stage I/O.
pipeline_integration.prop_placement_flow: NPropStage -> PositionProvider.positionsIn() -> Assignments.propAt() -> Prop.scan() -> Prop.place() -> VoxelSpace.set() / EntityContainer.add()
pipeline_integration.terrain_generation_flow: NTerrainStage -> Density.process() for each voxel -> MaterialProvider.getVoxelTypeAt() for solid voxels -> VoxelSpace.set(Material)

server_worldgen_bridge.overview: ChunkGenerator.generate() produces GeneratedChunk consumed by the server worldgen system. FallbackGenerator provides empty chunks on error. WorldStructure's biomeMap (BiCarta<Integer>) is sampled by NBiomeStage for biome resolution. ChunkRequest.GeneratorProfile serves as the cache key for generator instances.

ecs_integration.overview: SolidMaterial.holder (Holder<ChunkStore>) connects generated blocks to ECS chunk stores. EntityPlacementData.entityHolder (Holder<EntityStore>) spawns entities. MaterialCache integrates with BlockType and Fluid asset maps for block/fluid ID resolution. ViewportCommand accesses TransformComponent, Player, BlockSelection via ECS Store/Ref.

protocol.overview: QUIC-based network protocol with Zstd compression, 270 packet types across 17 categories, uniform code-generated binary serialization, 3 network channels, and protocol version 2 build 20.

type_hierarchy.overview: Four abstract polymorphic base types use VarInt type-id discriminated unions for deserialization. Two interfaces define the packet contract. All concrete data types follow a uniform code-generated pattern with static NULLABLE_BIT_FIELD_SIZE, FIXED_BLOCK_SIZE, VARIABLE_FIELD_COUNT, VARIABLE_BLOCK_START, MAX_SIZE constants plus serialize/deserialize/computeSize/clone/equals/hashCode methods.

abstract_base_types.name: ComponentUpdate
abstract_base_types.description: Polymorphic base for ECS component updates sent in EntityUpdate packets. 26 concrete subtypes identified by VarInt type ID (0-25).

abstract_base_types.name: Interaction
abstract_base_types.description: Polymorphic base for item/ability interaction definitions. 45 concrete subtypes (IDs 0-44, gap at 19). Common fields: waitForDataFrom, effects, horizontalSpeedMultiplier, runTime, cancelOnItemChange, settings, rules, tags, camera.

abstract_base_types.name: Selector
abstract_base_types.description: Polymorphic base for targeting selectors used in interactions. 5 concrete subtypes.

abstract_base_types.name: ParamValue
abstract_base_types.description: Polymorphic base for typed parameter values. 5 concrete subtypes for String, Bool, Double, Int, Long.

interfaces.name: Packet
interfaces.description: Root packet interface. Methods: getId(), getChannel(), serialize(ByteBuf), computeSize().

wrapper_types.name: CachedPacket<T extends ToClientPacket>
wrapper_types.description: Wraps a ToClientPacket by pre-serializing its bytes into a ByteBuf for efficient re-sending. Uses Netty reference counting.

message_definitions.overview: The protocol root package does not contain individual packet message classes (those are in com.hypixel.hytale.protocol.packets.*). Instead, it defines the data structures that packet payloads carry. The key composite message type in scope is EntityUpdate, which wraps a networkId, optional removed ComponentUpdateType[], and optional ComponentUpdate[] array — forming the core entity state replication mechanism.

types.name: EntityUpdate
types.description: Carries per-entity component state changes. Contains networkId (int), removed (ComponentUpdateType[]), and updates (ComponentUpdate[]). Used in entity state replication packets.

types.name: InteractionSyncData
types.description: Synchronizes interaction execution state between client and server. Contains progress, operation counter, root interaction ID, block position, block face, hit entities, attacker position/rotation, raycast data, movement direction, apply force state, and more.

types.name: InteractionChainData
types.description: Data structure for tracking interaction chain execution context, including proxy entity ID, hit location, hit detail string, block position, and hit normal.

types.name: FormattedMessage
types.description: Rich text message structure with recursive children, color, bold/italic/monospace/underlined formatting, and hyperlink support.

serialization.overview: All protocol types follow a uniform code-generated binary serialization pattern using Netty ByteBuf. Types have a fixed-size block (containing primitive and fixed-size struct fields) followed by a variable-size block (for strings, arrays, maps, and variable-sized nested structs). Nullable fields use bit-field bytes at the start. Variable fields use 4-byte LE offset slots pointing into the variable block. Polymorphic types use VarInt type-ID prefix for deserialization dispatch.

patterns.name: Fixed+Variable Block Layout
patterns.description: Each type declares NULLABLE_BIT_FIELD_SIZE, FIXED_BLOCK_SIZE, VARIABLE_FIELD_COUNT, VARIABLE_BLOCK_START, MAX_SIZE. The binary layout is: [null-bits] [fixed fields] [variable offset slots (4 bytes each)] [variable data]. Variable offset slots store relative offsets from the variable block start; -1 means null.
examples: AmbienceFX: 1 null byte + 18 fixed bytes + 6x4 offset slots = 42 bytes before variable data

patterns.name: Null Bit Fields
patterns.description: First N bytes are null-bit fields. Each bit indicates whether a nullable field is present. Bit ordering is LSB-first within each byte.
examples: AmbienceFXConditions uses 2 null-bit bytes for 10 nullable fields

patterns.name: VarInt Length-Prefixed Arrays
patterns.description: Arrays are serialized as VarInt count followed by elements. Fixed-size elements are packed contiguously; variable-size elements use per-element computeBytesConsumed. Max array length is typically 4,096,000.

patterns.name: VarInt-Prefixed Strings
patterns.description: Strings use PacketIO.readVarString/writeVarString: VarInt byte-length prefix + UTF-8 bytes. Max string length is typically 4,096,000 bytes.
examples: Asset.hash uses fixed 64-byte encoding, but most strings use VarInt prefix

patterns.name: Polymorphic Type-ID Dispatch
patterns.description: Abstract types (ComponentUpdate, Interaction, Selector, ParamValue) use VarInt type-ID at the start of serialized data. Deserialization reads the type-ID and dispatches to the concrete subtype's deserialize method.

patterns.name: Dictionary/Map Serialization
patterns.description: Maps are serialized as VarInt count + key-value pairs. Keys are typically enum values (1 byte) and values are either primitives or nested structs.

patterns.name: Bitfield-Encoded String Arrays
patterns.description: Some nullable-element string arrays (like activeAnimations) use a bitfield to indicate which elements are non-null, followed by the non-null strings.

patterns.name: Little-Endian Byte Order
patterns.description: All multi-byte primitives use little-endian encoding (getIntLE, getFloatLE, etc.).

enums.overview: 60 enum types in the A-I range. All follow an identical pattern: int-valued variants, static VALUES array, getValue(), fromValue(int) with ProtocolException on invalid value. These enums define game constants for block types, interaction types, animation slots, camera modes, game modes, entity stats, item slots, and more.

data_types.overview: The A-I range contains extensive data structure definitions covering spatial data, colors, ranges, game object definitions (blocks, items, fluids), visual effects, and game mechanics. These are pure data containers (POJOs) with serialization support.

block_types.name: BlockType
block_types.description: Comprehensive block definition with 30+ fields covering rendering (drawType, material, opacity, shaderEffect, model, textures, shadingMode), physics (movementSettings, hitbox), gameplay (flags, gathering, placementSettings), visual effects (particles, light, tint), and metadata (item, name, tags).

block_types.name: BlockTextures
block_types.description: Per-face texture references for cube blocks

item_types.name: ItemBase
item_types.description: Comprehensive item definition with 25+ fields covering identity (id, model, texture, animation, icon), categories, tool/weapon/armor/glider/utility specs, visual effects (particles, trails, light), interaction config, durability, and sound.

item_types.name: ItemLibrary
item_types.description: Array container for all item definitions

item_types.name: ItemCategory
item_types.description: Hierarchical item category with recursive children

interaction_system_types.name: ForkedChainId
interaction_system_types.description: Recursive chain ID for forked interaction chains

protocol_infrastructure.name: ProtocolSettings
protocol_infrastructure.description: Protocol version constants: PROTOCOL_CRC=-1356075132, PROTOCOL_VERSION=2, PROTOCOL_BUILD_NUMBER=20, PACKET_COUNT=268, STRUCT_COUNT=339, ENUM_COUNT=137, MAX_PACKET_SIZE=1677721600

protocol_infrastructure.name: PacketRegistry
protocol_infrastructure.description: Central registry mapping packet IDs to packet types. References all packet classes from com.hypixel.hytale.protocol.packets.* sub-packages. Out of A-I scope for detailed analysis but critical infrastructure.

type_hierarchy.overview: Three major abstract polymorphic hierarchies exist in this range, plus the core Packet interface. Interaction is the base for all interaction types (dispatched via VarInt type ID). Selector is the base for target-selection shapes. ParamValue is the base for typed parameter values. ComponentUpdate is the base for entity component state updates.

base_types.name: Packet
base_types.description: Core packet interface. Defines getId(), getChannel(), serialize(ByteBuf), computeSize(). All network messages implement this.

base_types.name: Interaction
base_types.description: Base for all interaction types. Common fields: waitForDataFrom, effects, horizontalSpeedMultiplier, runTime, cancelOnItemChange, settings (Map<GameMode, InteractionSettings>), rules, tags, camera. Uses VarInt type ID for polymorphic deserialization.

base_types.name: SimpleInteraction
base_types.description: Adds next/failed chain pointers to Interaction base. Most concrete interactions extend this.

base_types.name: SimpleBlockInteraction
base_types.description: Adds useLatestTarget boolean for block-targeting interactions.

base_types.name: Selector
base_types.description: Base for target selection shapes. Subtypes: AOECircleSelector(0), AOECylinderSelector(1), RaycastSelector(2), HorizontalSelector(3), StabSelector(4). Uses VarInt type ID polymorphism.

base_types.name: ParamValue
base_types.description: Base for typed parameter values. Subtypes: StringParamValue(0), BoolParamValue(1), DoubleParamValue(2), IntParamValue(3), LongParamValue(4). Uses VarInt type ID polymorphism.

base_types.name: ComponentUpdate
base_types.description: Base for entity component state updates sent from server to client. 25+ subtypes dispatched by VarInt type ID. Includes model, transform, equipment, stats, effects, nameplate, skin, movement states, etc.

message_definitions.overview: The PacketRegistry statically registers 268 packets across 14 sub-packages (asseteditor, assets, auth, buildertools, camera, connection, entities, interaction, interface_, inventory, machinima, player, serveraccess, setup, window, world, worldmap). Packets are registered with direction (ToServer/ToClient/Both), NetworkChannel, numeric ID, validation function, and deserializer. CachedPacket<T> wraps ToClientPacket for pre-serialized reuse.

types.name: PacketRegistry
types.description: Static registry of all 268 packet types. Maps packet ID to PacketInfo (id, name, channel, type, fixedBlockSize, maxSize, compressed, validate, deserialize). Provides lookup by ID or class. Inner record PacketInfo and enum PacketDirection (ToServer, ToClient, Both).

types.name: CachedPacket
types.description: Wraps a pre-serialized ToClientPacket in a ByteBuf for efficient rebroadcast to multiple clients.

types.name: ProtocolSettings
types.description: Protocol version constants. PROTOCOL_CRC=-1356075132, PROTOCOL_VERSION=2, PROTOCOL_BUILD_NUMBER=20, PACKET_COUNT=268, STRUCT_COUNT=339, ENUM_COUNT=137, MAX_PACKET_SIZE=1677721600.

serialization.overview: All struct types follow a uniform binary serialization pattern over Netty ByteBuf. Each type declares NULLABLE_BIT_FIELD_SIZE, FIXED_BLOCK_SIZE, VARIABLE_FIELD_COUNT, VARIABLE_BLOCK_START, and MAX_SIZE constants. Serialization layout: [nullable bit flags] [fixed-size fields at known offsets] [offset table for variable fields] [variable-length data block]. Strings use VarInt-prefixed UTF-8 via PacketIO. Arrays use VarInt count prefix. Dictionaries use VarInt count then key-value pairs. Polymorphic types use VarInt type ID prefix. Validation checks buffer bounds, string lengths (max 4096000), array lengths (max 4096000).

patterns.name: Nullable bit fields
patterns.description: First N bytes encode which nullable fields are present, using bit flags (nullBits & 1, nullBits & 2, etc.).

patterns.name: Fixed block
patterns.description: Non-nullable primitive fields and nullable fixed-size structs are written at known offsets within the fixed block.

patterns.name: Variable offset table
patterns.description: After the fixed block, 4-byte LE int offsets point into the variable data block. -1 indicates null. Offsets are relative to the variable block start.

patterns.name: Variable data block
patterns.description: Variable-length data (strings, arrays, nested variable structs, dictionaries) written sequentially.

patterns.name: VarInt polymorphism
patterns.description: Abstract types (Interaction, Selector, ParamValue, ComponentUpdate) prefix data with a VarInt type ID to select the concrete subtype.

patterns.name: Little-endian
patterns.description: All multi-byte integers and floats use little-endian byte order (getIntLE, getFloatLE, getDoubleLE, getLongLE).

enums.overview: 55 enums in the L-Z range encode game constants. All follow the same pattern: int-valued constants, static VALUES array, getValue(), fromValue(int) with ProtocolException on invalid value. NetworkChannel is the only exception (uses IllegalArgumentException).

types.name: NetworkChannel
types.note: Also has COUNT field. Uses IllegalArgumentException instead of ProtocolException.

data_types.overview: 110+ data structure classes in this range serve as protocol DTOs. They fall into several functional groups: spatial/math primitives, model/rendering, particle/VFX, sound/audio, movement/physics, interaction system, entity components, items/inventory, objectives/UI, world/environment, and miscellaneous.

io_infrastructure.overview: The protocol.io package provides the binary serialization layer. PacketIO handles framing, compression, and primitive read/write. VarInt implements variable-length integer encoding. PacketDecoder/PacketEncoder are Netty channel handlers. ProtocolUtil manages QUIC connection lifecycle. PacketStatsRecorder tracks bandwidth statistics per packet type.

types.name: PacketIO
types.description: Central serialization utility. Handles framed packet read/write with Zstd compression, half-float (16-bit) encoding, UUID read/write, fixed and variable-length string encoding (UTF-8 and ASCII), and byte/short/float array I/O. All reads use absolute ByteBuf offsets (getByte, getIntLE); writes use sequential (writeByte, writeIntLE).
key_methods: writeFramedPacket(Packet, Class, ByteBuf, PacketStatsRecorder) — serializes a packet with 4-byte LE length prefix + 4-byte LE packet ID + optional Zstd compression
readFramedPacket(ByteBuf, int, PacketStatsRecorder) — reads packet ID, looks up PacketInfo, delegates to readFramedPacketWithInfo
readFramedPacketWithInfo(ByteBuf, int, PacketInfo, PacketStatsRecorder) — handles decompression if compressed, then calls info.deserialize()
readVarString / writeVarString — VarInt-length-prefixed UTF-8 strings with max-length enforcement

constants.COMPRESSION_LEVEL: System property hytale.protocol.compressionLevel, defaults to Zstd.defaultCompressionLevel()

wire_format.frame: [4 bytes LE payload length] [4 bytes LE packet ID] [payload bytes, optionally Zstd-compressed]

types.name: VarInt
types.description: Variable-length integer encoding (1-5 bytes, 7 bits per byte, MSB continuation bit). Used for array lengths, string lengths, and polymorphic type IDs throughout the protocol. Does not support negative values.
key_methods: peek(ByteBuf, int) — decode at absolute offset without advancing
length(ByteBuf, int) — return byte count of VarInt at offset
size(int) — compute encoded byte count without writing

types.name: PacketStatsRecorder
types.description: Per-connection bandwidth statistics tracker. Records send/receive counts, uncompressed/compressed sizes, min/max/avg, and 30-second rolling stats per packet ID. Stored as a Netty channel attribute. Default implementation is NoopPacketStatsRecorder.

types.name: NoopPacketStatsRecorder
types.description: No-op implementation of PacketStatsRecorder. All methods return zero/empty. Used when stats recording is disabled.

types.name: PacketDecoder
types.description: Netty inbound handler that decodes framed packets from the byte stream. Reads 4-byte LE payload length + 4-byte LE packet ID, validates against PacketRegistry (ToServer direction), checks NetworkChannel match, decompresses if needed, and outputs deserialized Packet objects. Implements a custom packet timeout (configurable via PACKET_TIMEOUT_KEY channel attribute) that fires ReadTimeoutException when no packets arrive within the deadline. Closes connection on any protocol violation.

types.name: PacketEncoder
types.description: Netty outbound handler that encodes Packet objects into framed bytes. Handles CachedPacket unwrapping, NetworkChannel validation, and delegates to PacketIO.writeFramedPacket(). Marked @Sharable so a single instance can be shared across channels.

types.name: ProtocolUtil
types.description: QUIC connection lifecycle utilities. Provides closeConnection() (transport error) and closeApplicationConnection() (application error with reason string). Defines application-level error codes and Netty channel attribute keys for stream channel ID and packet timeout.
attribute_keys: STREAM_CHANNEL_KEY (NetworkChannel) — identifies which logical channel this QUIC stream belongs to
PACKET_TIMEOUT_KEY (Duration) — configurable timeout for idle connections

network_channels.overview: Three logical channels multiplex over the QUIC connection. Each packet is registered to exactly one channel. The decoder validates that incoming packets match the stream's assigned channel.

packet_registration.overview: PacketRegistry is a static registry mapping integer IDs to PacketInfo records. Registration happens in a static initializer block. Each registration specifies direction (ToServer/ToClient/Both), NetworkChannel, numeric ID, name, Java class, fixedBlockSize, maxSize, compressed flag, validate function, and deserialize function. The registry maintains three maps: BY_ID (all), TO_SERVER_BY_ID, TO_CLIENT_BY_ID, plus BY_TYPE for class-to-ID lookup.

packet_structure_pattern.overview: All packet classes are code-generated and follow a uniform structure. They have static constants (PACKET_ID, IS_COMPRESSED, NULLABLE_BIT_FIELD_SIZE, FIXED_BLOCK_SIZE, VARIABLE_FIELD_COUNT, VARIABLE_BLOCK_START, MAX_SIZE), public fields for payload data, and standard methods (deserialize, serialize, computeSize, computeBytesConsumed, validateStructure, clone, equals, hashCode). The binary layout is: [nullable bit field bytes] [fixed-size fields in LE byte order] [variable field offset table as LE int32s] [variable-length data (strings, arrays, nested structs)].

to_server_core.overview: The protocol root package is a pure data-definition layer with no direct imports from server.core. Instead, it defines the wire-format types that server.core implementations serialize into. Cross-references are implicit: e.g., EntityUpdate.networkId maps to server-side entity IDs; BlockType.blockId maps to server block registry indices; GameMode enum values correspond to server game mode state.
to_server_core.entity_system: EntityUpdate + ComponentUpdate hierarchy defines the ECS replication format. ComponentUpdateType enum (26 values) maps 1:1 to server-side ECS component types.
to_server_core.interaction_system: Interaction hierarchy (45 subtypes) defines the complete interaction/ability system wire format. InteractionType enum (25 values) maps to server-side interaction triggers.
to_server_core.block_system: BlockType is the comprehensive block definition. BlockFace, BlockNeighbor, BlockMaterial, DrawType, Opacity, ShadingMode enums define the block rendering/physics model.
to_server_core.item_system: ItemBase + ItemLibrary define the complete item data model. ItemTool, ItemWeapon, ItemArmor, ItemGlider, ItemUtility are specialized sub-configs.
to_server_core.crafting_system: CraftingRecipe, Bench, BenchRequirement, MaterialQuantity define the crafting system data model.

root_a_cross_references.index_based_references: Many fields use integer indices (e.g., soundEventIndex, blockSoundSetIndex, audioCategoryIndex, fluidFXIndex, entityStatIndex, qualityIndex, reticleIndex) rather than string IDs. These reference positions in server-side registry arrays that are transmitted to clients during connection/world loading.
root_a_cross_references.tag_pattern_system: Several types reference tagPatternIndex and tagIndexes fields, indicating a tag-based pattern matching system for blocks, environments, weather, etc.

When an NPC dies, the marker respawns after a cooldown (real-time or game-time). Markers deactivate when no players are within DeactivationDistance and store their NPCs as StoredFlock.

Flocks are configured via FlockAsset (JSON) which specifies size ranges, grow limits, and blocked roles. The flock plugin provides 10 NPC core component types for AI integration.

flock_membership.overview: Entities join flocks via FlockMembershipSystems.join() which creates a FlockMembership component with JOINING type. The RefChange system processes the join: validates the entity (alive, adventure mode for players, flock data loaded, role allowed), adds to EntityGroup, and elects leader. Leader election prefers: (1) the entity with LEADER type from persistence, (2) players always become leader, (3) first joiner. When a member leaves or dies, the system re-elects from remaining members using canBecomeLeader (players or NPCs with role.isCanLeadFlock()).
