math.purpose: Core math library providing vector types, matrix operations, shapes, raycasting, block geometry iteration, hit detection, and numeric utilities. All vector types are mutable with fluent APIs, cached hash codes, and codec integration for JSON serialization.

vectors.purpose: Comprehensive set of 2D, 3D, and 4D vector types covering int, long, float, and double precisions. All are mutable classes with fluent modifier methods that return 'this'. Hash codes are lazily computed and cached (reset to 0 on mutation).

Vec2f.purpose: Lightweight 2D float vector for network serialization. No arithmetic operations — used as a raw data carrier.

Vec3f.purpose: Lightweight 3D float vector for network serialization. No arithmetic operations.

Vec4f.purpose: Immutable 4D float vector for network serialization.

Vector2d.purpose: Full-featured 2D double vector with arithmetic, distance, normalization, interpolation. Random constructor for random direction.

Vector2l.purpose: Full-featured 2D long vector, for world-space coordinate precision.

Vector3d.purpose: Primary 3D double vector — the most widely used spatial type. Supports yaw/pitch construction for direction vectors, axis rotations, block containment testing, and conversion to int/float variants.

Vector3f.dual_purpose: Used as both a spatial vector (x,y,z) and a rotation (pitch=x, yaw=y, roll=z)
Vector3f.purpose: 3D float vector dual-purposed as rotation holder. lookAt() computes yaw/pitch from relative position. lerpAngle() for smooth rotation interpolation.

Vector3i.purpose: 3D integer vector — fundamental block coordinate type. Widely used for block positions throughout the server.

Vector3l.purpose: 3D long vector for world-space precision. toVector3i uses MathUtil.floor.

Vector4d.purpose: Homogeneous 4D vector for projection/view transformations. w=1 for positions, w=0 for directions. perspectiveTransform divides by w.

relative_vectors.purpose: Wrappers that pair a vector with a 'relative' boolean flag. When relative=true, resolve() adds the stored vector to the input; otherwise returns a clone of the input. All have BuilderCodec with Vector + Relative fields.

Transform.relative_flags: Bitmask constants: X_IS_RELATIVE=1, Y_IS_RELATIVE=2, Z_IS_RELATIVE=4, YAW_IS_RELATIVE=8, PITCH_IS_RELATIVE=16, ROLL_IS_RELATIVE=32, RELATIVE_TO_BLOCK=64
Transform.purpose: Position + rotation pair with relative transform support via bitmask. applyMaskedRelativeTransform applies selective relative offsets from a source.

Location.purpose: World-qualified position + rotation. Extends Transform concept with an optional world name string.

VectorBoxUtil.purpose: Iterates over collections of positioned objects, invoking a consumer for each within an axis-aligned box (apothem-based). Optimized path for FastCollection inputs. Supports Iterable and Int2ObjectMap inputs with 1-3 extra consumer parameters.

VectorSphereUtil.purpose: Same as VectorBoxUtil but with ellipsoidal distance check (x/rx)^2 + (y/ry)^2 + (z/rz)^2 <= 1. Supports separate radii per axis.

Mat4f.purpose: Immutable 4x4 float matrix for network serialization (ByteBuf). 16 public final float fields. SIZE=64 bytes. Has identity() factory and serialize/deserialize.

Matrix4d.purpose: Full 4x4 double matrix used for view, projection, and model transforms. Supports orthogonal/frustum/cone projection setup, look-at view matrix, axis/euler rotation, matrix multiplication, inversion, and vector transformation.

Quatf.purpose: Immutable quaternion for network serialization. No rotation operations — purely a data carrier.

Axis.purpose: Axis enum with 90-degree rotation and flip operations for block-aligned transforms.

Range.purpose: Simple mutable float min/max range. No interpolation.

FloatRange.purpose: Inclusive float range with factor-based interpolation: getFloat(factor) returns min + range * factor, clamped to max.

IntRange.purpose: Inclusive int range with factor-based interpolation using fastFloor.

IntRangeBoundValidator.purpose: Codec validator that enforces min/max bounds on either the lower or upper bound of an IntRange. Updates schema with integer constraints.

codecs.purpose: Array-format codecs for serializing math types to/from JSON arrays and BSON.

types.FloatRangeArrayCodec: Serializes FloatRange as [min, max] JSON array. Validates min <= max.
types.IntRangeArrayCodec: Serializes IntRange as [min, max] JSON array. Validates min <= max.
types.Vector2dArrayCodec: Deprecated. Serializes Vector2d as [x, y] array.
types.Vector3dArrayCodec: Deprecated. Serializes Vector3d as [x, y, z] array.
types.Vector3iArrayCodec: Deprecated. Serializes Vector3i as [x, y, z] array.

codecs.note: Array codecs are deprecated in favor of BuilderCodec with named keys (X/Y/Z).

Shape.purpose: Base interface for 3D shapes that support point containment and block iteration.

Box.purpose: Axis-aligned bounding box — the primary 3D shape type. Supports intersection, overlap testing, block iteration (including edges and faces only), axis rotation, and expansion.

Cylinder.purpose: Cylindrical shape with elliptical cross-section and block iteration.

Ellipsoid.purpose: Ellipsoidal shape with per-axis radii and block iteration.

OriginShape.purpose: Wraps a Shape with an origin offset for positioned shapes.

Quad4d.purpose: 4D quadrilateral (4 Vector4d vertices) for hit detection in projected space. Supports matrix multiplication, frustum test, random point sampling.

Triangle2d.purpose: 2D triangle with barycentric coordinate containment test.

Triangle4d.purpose: 4D triangle for hit detection — stores visible triangle after frustum clipping for random hit point sampling.

block_geometry.purpose: Block-level shape iteration utilities. Each generates block coordinates inside or on the surface of a geometric primitive. All use TriIntPredicate or TriIntObjPredicate callbacks that return false to abort iteration early.

types.BlockSphereUtil: Iterates blocks inside a sphere/ellipsoid. Supports solid and hollow (shell) modes with configurable thickness.
types.BlockCubeUtil: Iterates blocks inside a cube. Supports solid and hollow modes.
types.BlockConeUtil: Iterates blocks inside a cone. Supports solid and hollow modes.
types.BlockCylinderUtil: Iterates blocks inside a cylinder. Supports solid and hollow modes.
types.BlockDiamondUtil: Iterates blocks inside a diamond (octahedron). Supports solid and hollow modes.
types.BlockDomeUtil: Iterates blocks inside a dome (upper hemisphere). Supports solid and hollow modes.
types.BlockInvertedDomeUtil: Iterates blocks inside an inverted dome (lower hemisphere).
types.BlockPyramidUtil: Iterates blocks inside a pyramid. Supports solid and hollow modes.
types.BlockTorusUtil: Iterates blocks inside a torus with major/minor radii.
types.BlockUtil: Shared inner utility — contains toEdge() helper for hollow shell generation.

BlockIterator.purpose: Voxel traversal (DDA ray marching) along a direction vector. Visits each block the ray passes through. Returns false to abort. Supports generic typed procedure callbacks.

BoxBlockIterator.purpose: Iterates all integer coordinates within a 3D box region.

LineIterator.purpose: Bresenham-style 3D line iterator between two integer coordinates.

CircleIterator.purpose: Iterates 2D coordinates in expanding concentric square rings.

CircleSpiralIterator.purpose: Iterates 2D coordinates in a spiral pattern from center outward.

SpiralIterator.purpose: Iterates 2D coordinates in an outward spiral, sorted by distance.

hit_detection.purpose: View-space hit detection system for testing whether 3D geometry (quads, points) is visible through a camera projection. Used for click/target detection.

HitDetectionExecutor.purpose: Core executor: combines projection + view matrices, transforms model quads into clip space, clips against frustum planes, picks random hit point on visible triangle, inverse-projects to world space, and tests line-of-sight. Returns closest visible hit.

types.HitDetectionBuffer: Scratch buffers for transformed quads, triangles, vertex lists during hit detection.
types.MatrixProvider: Interface returning a Matrix4d — used for projection and view matrix sources.
types.LineOfSightProvider: Interface testing if a ray from origin to hit point is unobstructed. Default returns true.
types.Vector4dBufferList: Fixed-capacity ring buffer of Vector4d for frustum clipping vertex lists.
types.FrustumProjectionProvider: Frustum (perspective) projection matrix provider with rotation. Codec-configurable.
types.OrthogonalProjectionProvider: Orthogonal projection matrix provider with rotation. Codec-configurable.
types.DirectionViewProvider: View matrix provider from position + direction + up vector. Codec-configurable yaw/pitch offsets.

RaycastAABB.purpose: Slab-method AABB ray intersection test. Returns nearest t-parameter. Variant methods provide hit normal (nx,ny,nz) via functional consumers. Supports 0-3 extra generic parameters on the consumer.

RandomExtra.purpose: ThreadLocalRandom-based utilities: randomBinomial, randomRange (int/long/float/double/Duration), randomBoolean, randomElement, randomWeightedElement (double/int weights, with/without filter), jitter (Vector3d), reservoirSample, pickWeightedIndex.

FastRandom.purpose: XorShift128+ PRNG. Faster than java.util.Random. Provides next(bits), nextLong, nextInt, nextDouble, nextFloat, nextBoolean. Seedable.

MathUtil.purpose: Central math utilities: clamp (int/float/double/long), floor/ceil (fast variants using int cast), fastRound, lerp, lerpAngle, wrapAngle, clipToZero, closeToZero, length(3d), toRadians, PITCH_EDGE_PADDING constant.

TrigMathUtil.purpose: Fast trigonometry using lookup tables with 65536 entries. sin, cos (float/double), atan2. Higher precision than standard Math.sin but faster.

HashUtil.purpose: Hash functions: hash(long...) for vector hash codes, coordHash(seed,x,y,z) for coordinate-seeded hashing, random(seed,x,y,z) returning [0,1) double from coordinate hash.

NumberUtil.purpose: Numeric parsing utilities: tryParseInt, tryParseLong, tryParseDouble, tryParseFloat with fallback defaults.

ChunkUtil.purpose: Chunk coordinate math: SIZE=32, HEIGHT=320, HEIGHT_SECTIONS=10. Block↔chunk index conversions, column indexing, chunk coordinate packing/unpacking to long, toByteArray converters. NOT_FOUND sentinel.

NearestBlockUtil.purpose: Finds the nearest block matching a predicate within a search radius using expanding search.

VarInt.purpose: Variable-length integer encoding/decoding (signed/unsigned, int/long) for DataInput/DataOutput and byte arrays. ZigZag encoding for signed values.

procedurallib.purpose: Procedural generation library providing noise functions, noise composition properties, cellular/point generators, conditions, coordinate randomizers, range suppliers, and JSON loaders for data-driven procedural configuration. This is a standalone library that the worldgen system builds upon.

noise_functions.purpose: Core noise function interfaces and implementations. All noise functions take a seed parameter and spatial coordinates, returning a value typically in [-1, 1] range.

interfaces.NoiseFunction: Combined 2D + 3D noise interface (extends NoiseFunction2d and NoiseFunction3d).
interfaces.NoiseFunction2d: FunctionalInterface: get(seed, seedOffset, x, y) → double.
interfaces.NoiseFunction3d: FunctionalInterface: get(seed, seedOffset, x, y, z) → double.

NoiseFunctionPair.purpose: Combines separate 2D and 3D noise functions into a single NoiseFunction implementation.

NoiseType.purpose: Enum identifying the algorithm type of a noise function.

SimplexNoise.purpose: Simplex noise implementation with 2D and 3D variants. Uses gradient tables and simplex grid.

OldSimplexNoise.purpose: Legacy simplex noise variant — different gradient computation.

PerlinNoise.purpose: Classic Perlin noise with 2D and 3D evaluation using fade/grad functions.

ValueNoise.purpose: Value noise — interpolates random values at integer lattice points.

CellNoise.purpose: Cell (Worley/Voronoi) noise based on CellDistanceFunction and PointEvaluator. Returns normalized distance to nearest cell point.

CellularNoise.purpose: Low-level cellular noise utilities: CELL_2D and CELL_3D lookup tables for cell point offsets (256 entries each).

ConstantNoise.purpose: Returns a fixed constant value for all coordinates.

MeshNoise.purpose: Mesh-based noise with configurable cell distance functions.

DistanceNoise.purpose: Distance-to-cell-center noise with configurable Distance2Function (LINEAR, CUBIC, FLAT, CIRCLE, DIAMOND, ROUNDED_SQUARE). Combines cell lookup with distance formula.

BranchNoise.purpose: Branch/river-like noise: generates linear features connecting cell centers. Uses parent cell lookup, line cell distance, and configurable fade/thickness/density.

PointNoise.purpose: Point-based noise using IPointGenerator for nearest/transition queries.

GeneralNoise.purpose: Shared noise utilities: fastFloor, interpolation helpers (interpHermite, interpQuintic), gradients (gradCoord2D/3D), limit() clamping to [0,1].

support_types.DoubleArray: Double2 and Double3 record-like classes for cell point offsets.
support_types.ResultBuffer: Thread-local result buffers (ResultBuffer2d, ResultBuffer3d, Bounds2d) holding nearest cell info: distance, cell hash, cell coordinates, point coordinates.

noise_properties.purpose: Composable noise decorators that transform, combine, or modify NoiseProperty instances. Each implements get(seed, x, y) and get(seed, x, y, z). This is the primary composition mechanism for building complex noise pipelines.

base_interface.NoiseProperty: Interface with get(seed, x, y) and get(seed, x, y, z) returning [0,1] range.

types.SingleNoiseProperty: Wraps a NoiseFunction with seed offset. Normalizes [-1,1] → [0,1] via value*0.5+0.5.
types.FractalNoiseProperty: Octave-based fractal noise with lacunarity, persistence, and configurable FractalFunction (FBM, RIGID_MULTI, BILLOW).
types.ScaleNoiseProperty: Scales input coordinates by scaleX/scaleY/scaleZ before delegating.
types.OffsetNoiseProperty: Adds offset to input coordinates before delegating.
types.RotateNoiseProperty: Rotates input coordinates via CoordinateRotator before delegating.
types.DistortedNoiseProperty: Applies coordinate randomizer (ICoordinateRandomizer) to inputs before delegating.
types.NormalizeNoiseProperty: Maps output from [min, min+range] → [0,1] via GeneralNoise.limit.
types.CurveNoiseProperty: Applies a DoubleUnaryOperator (e.g. PowerCurve, BezierCurve) to output. PowerCurve: a*x^b clamped.
types.NoiseFormulaProperty: Applies a formula enum (NORMAL, ABS, INV_ABS, SQUARED) to output.
types.SumNoiseProperty: Weighted sum of multiple properties. Each Entry has a factor. Result clamped to [0,1].
types.MaxNoiseProperty: Takes maximum of multiple properties. Short-circuits at >0.999999.
types.MinNoiseProperty: Takes minimum of multiple properties. Short-circuits at <0.00001.
types.BlendNoiseProperty: Blends between multiple properties based on an alpha property and threshold array (lerp between adjacent thresholds).
types.GradientNoiseProperty: Computes gradient (magnitude, angle, or absolute angle) of noise using finite differences.

cellular_system.purpose: Voronoi/cellular noise infrastructure with cell distance functions, point evaluators, and jitter control.

cell_distance_functions.CellDistanceFunction: Interface for computing nearest cell point in 2D/3D. Supports nearest, transition (two nearest), and collect operations.
cell_distance_functions.GridCellDistanceFunction: Square grid cells with hash-based point offsets.
cell_distance_functions.HexCellDistanceFunction: Hexagonal grid cells with hex-to-cartesian scaling.
cell_distance_functions.BorderDistanceFunction: Computes distance to cell border rather than center.
cell_distance_functions.PointDistanceFunction: Interface for distance metric: distance2D/3D. Implementations in DistanceCalculationMode.

DistanceCalculationMode.purpose: Each provides a PointDistanceFunction. NATURAL = euclidean + manhattan.

point_evaluators.PointEvaluator: Interface for evaluating cell points: registers distance/hash into ResultBuffer. Supports 2D and 3D, plus point collection.
point_evaluators.NormalPointEvaluator: Standard distance-based evaluator with predefined EUCLIDEAN/MANHATTAN/NATURAL/MAX instances.
point_evaluators.DistancePointEvaluator: Distance evaluator with configurable distance modifier (ISeedDoubleRange).
point_evaluators.DensityPointEvaluator: Wraps evaluator with density condition — skips cells that fail IIntCondition based on hash.
point_evaluators.JitterPointEvaluator: Wraps evaluator with CellJitter for point offset scaling.
point_evaluators.SkipCellPointEvaluator: Wraps evaluator to skip cells in a pattern (CHECKERBOARD, ALTERNATING) based on cell coordinates.
point_evaluators.BorderPointEvaluator: Computes perpendicular distance to cell border midpoint.
point_evaluators.BranchEvaluator: Complex evaluator for branch/river features: connects parent cell to neighbor via line distance.

cell_jitter.CellJitter: Interface controlling how much cell points deviate from cell centers.

cell_types.CellPointFunction: Interface for cell point hash/offset computation.

point_generators.purpose: Generators that produce nearest-point queries for cellular features. Used by PointNoise and other spatial systems.

types.PointGenerator: Core implementation using CellDistanceFunction + PointEvaluator + seedOffset.

point_generators.PointConsumer: Generic callback for point collection: accept(x, y, T).

conditions.purpose: Boolean condition types used by the procedural system for threshold checks, noise masks, coordinate evaluation, and density control.

interfaces.IDoubleThreshold: eval(double) and eval(double, factor) → boolean. Factor-parameterized thresholds.
interfaces.ICoordinateCondition: eval(seed, x, y) and eval(seed, x, y, z) → boolean.
interfaces.ICoordinateRndCondition: eval(seed, x, z, y, Random) → boolean.
interfaces.IHeightThresholdInterpreter: Height-dependent threshold: getThreshold(seed, x, y, height) → float. Includes getLowestNonOne, getHighestNonZero, isSpawnable.

implementations.DoubleThreshold.Single: Min/max range threshold with factor-based narrowing.
implementations.NoiseMaskCondition: Evaluates NoiseProperty at coordinates, then applies IDoubleCondition to result.
implementations.HeightCondition: Uses IHeightThresholdInterpreter; passes if threshold > random().
implementations.HeightThresholdCoordinateCondition: Uses IHeightThresholdInterpreter; passes if threshold >= coordHash random.
implementations.BasicHeightThresholdInterpreter: Interpolates threshold array by height. Pre-computes lowestNonOne/highestNonZero.
implementations.NoiseHeightThresholdInterpreter: Blends between multiple BasicHeightThresholdInterpreters based on noise value.

random_utilities.purpose: Coordinate transformation and randomization for procedural distortion.

types.CoordinateRandomizer: Applies noise-based amplitude randomization per axis using AmplitudeNoiseProperty arrays.
types.CoordinateRotator: Applies 2D/3D rotation matrix from pitch/yaw angles. Pre-computes 3x3 rotation matrix.
types.CoordinateOriginRotator: CoordinateRotator with origin offset — rotates around a specific point.

suppliers.purpose: Value supplier interfaces and implementations for coordinate-dependent double/float values. Used to parameterize noise and conditions.

interfaces.IDoubleCoordinateSupplier: get(seed, x, y) and get(seed, x, y, z).

implementations.DoubleRange.Constant: Fixed value. ZERO and ONE singletons.
implementations.ConstantDoubleCoordinateHashSupplier: Fixed double. ZERO and ONE singletons.
implementations.ConstantFloatCoordinateHashSupplier: Fixed float. ZERO and ONE singletons.

file_system.purpose: Procedural library's own asset/file loading abstraction — separate from the main assetstore package.

types.AssetPath: Immutable path pair: relative path + absolute filepath. Comparable. Factory methods fromAbsolute/fromRelative.
types.FileIO: Static utility interface for file operations: exists, resolve, load, list (with disable/filter). Platform-independent path comparison (name-by-name). Thread-local FileIOSystem.
types.FileIOSystem: Interface for file system abstraction: baseRoot, roots (layered path array), resolve, load. Thread-local provider pattern. Default uses current directory.

json_loaders.purpose: JSON configuration loaders for data-driven procedural generation parameters. Each loader reads a Gson JsonElement and produces the corresponding noise/condition/property object.

base_types.JsonLoader<K,T>: Abstract base class with seed string, data folder, json element. Provides helpers: loadNoise, loadCondition, loadDouble, loadProperty, etc.
base_types.SeedString<K>: Seed key string for hierarchical resource identification.
base_types.NoiseTypeJson: Maps NoiseType enum to the corresponding JsonLoader class.

IntToIntFunction.purpose: int → int function, used by IIntCondition.

assetstore.purpose: Generic asset loading, registration, and management framework. Assets are JSON-configured game data objects loaded from asset packs, decoded via codecs, stored in typed AssetMaps, and managed through AssetStore lifecycle events. Supports inheritance (parent assets), tags, validation, and layered pack loading.

AssetStore.purpose: Central asset store managing a single asset type. Handles loading, validation, registration, removal, and iteration of assets. Supports layered loading from multiple packs with load-order dependencies (loadsBefore/loadsAfter). Fires lifecycle events.

AssetRegistry.purpose: Registry of all AssetStore instances. Manages store registration, topological ordering based on load dependencies, and coordinated loading/unloading across all stores.

JsonAsset<K>.purpose: Base class for all loadable game assets. Has key (K), tags (String[]), and parent reference. Tags are expanded into flat+keyed forms (e.g., Material, Solid, Material=Solid).

RawAsset.purpose: Unstructured raw asset as a JSON element before decoding.

DecodedAsset<K,T>.purpose: Holder for a decoded asset paired with its AssetExtraInfo metadata.

AssetPack.purpose: Represents a loaded asset pack (directory of asset files). Tracks pack path and manages the files within.

AssetHolder<K,T>.purpose: Wrapper holding an asset reference with its store context.

AssetLoadResult.purpose: Enum describing the outcome of an individual asset load attempt.

AssetUpdateQuery.purpose: Query object for determining which assets need updating during a reload.

AssetKeyValidator.purpose: Validates asset keys (typically strings) against naming rules.

AssetValidationResults.purpose: Collects validation warnings and errors during asset loading.

AssetReferences.purpose: Tracks cross-references between assets for dependency resolution.

MissingAssetException.purpose: Thrown when a required asset is not found in the store.

AssetConstants.purpose: Magic number constants: EXPECTED_CHILDREN_PER_ASSET=3, EXPECTED_ASSETS_PER_PATH=1, EXPECTED_VALUES_PER_TAG=3, EXPECTED_ASSETS_PER_TAG=3.

AssetExtraInfo<K>.purpose: Extended codec ExtraInfo carrying asset path, parent chain, tag resolver, and cross-reference tracking for use during decoding.

codec_system.purpose: Asset-specific codec types that extend the general codec framework for asset serialization.

AssetCodec<K,T>.purpose: Interface adding asset-specific decode: decodeAsset(BsonValue, AssetExtraInfo). Handles ID extraction, parent resolution, and tag processing.

AssetBuilderCodec<K,T>.purpose: Primary asset codec builder. Manages ID field, parent inheritance, tags codec (Map<String, String[]>), and asset-specific schema generation. Supports inheritable fields that fall back to parent values.

AssetCodecMapCodec.purpose: Codec for maps whose values are assets (keyed by asset ID).

ContainedAssetCodec<K,T>.purpose: Codec for assets that are contained/nested within other assets.

asset_maps.purpose: Storage containers for loaded assets, providing key-based and index-based lookup.

AssetMap<K,T>.purpose: Base interface for asset storage maps.

DefaultAssetMap<K,T>.purpose: Simple HashMap-backed asset map. The default storage for most asset types.

IndexedAssetMap<K,T>.purpose: Assets stored with integer indices for fast array-style access.

IndexedLookupTableAssetMap<K,T>.purpose: Integer-indexed with secondary lookup table for tag-based queries.

LookupTableAssetMap<K,T>.purpose: Asset map with secondary tag-based lookup tables.

AssetMapWithIndexes<K,T>.purpose: AssetMap augmented with integer index assignment.

ProvidedIndexAssetMap<K,T>.purpose: Asset map where indices are provided by the assets themselves.

BlockTypeAssetMap.purpose: Specialized asset map for block types.

CaseInsensitiveHashStrategy.purpose: fastutil hash strategy for case-insensitive string keys.

JsonAssetWithMap.purpose: JsonAsset variant that carries its own sub-map of child assets.

events.purpose: Lifecycle events fired during asset store operations.

types.AssetStoreEvent: Base event for asset store operations.
types.RegisterAssetStoreEvent: Fired when an AssetStore is registered with the AssetRegistry.
types.RemoveAssetStoreEvent: Fired when an AssetStore is removed from the registry.
types.AssetsEvent: Base for events related to asset content changes.
types.LoadedAssetsEvent: Fired after assets are loaded into a store.
types.RemovedAssetsEvent: Fired after assets are removed from a store.
types.GenerateAssetsEvent: Fired to trigger programmatic asset generation.
types.AssetStoreMonitorEvent: Monitoring event for asset store operations (extends MonitorEvent).
types.AssetMonitorEvent: Monitoring event for individual asset operations (extends MonitorEvent).

AssetStoreIterator.purpose: Topological sort iterator for AssetStore load order. Resolves loadsBefore/loadsAfter dependencies.

CircularDependencyException.purpose: Thrown when asset store load dependencies form a cycle.

common.purpose: Shared utility classes used across multiple subsystems: benchmarking, custom collections, weighted maps, plugin metadata, semantic versioning, threading, tuples, and general-purpose utilities.

benchmark.purpose: Performance measurement utilities for tracking min/max/average/count statistics.

types.ContinuousValueRecorder: Tracks min/max/sum/count for double values. reset(), record(double), getAverage/Min/Max.
types.DiscreteValueRecorder: Tracks min/max/sum/count for long values with formatted table output.
types.TimeRecorder: Records execution time using System.nanoTime. start/stop/reset pattern.
types.TimeDistributionRecorder: Combines TimeRecorder with DiscreteValueRecorder for timing distributions.

collections.purpose: Custom collection types for performance-sensitive scenarios.

BucketList<T extends BucketItem>.purpose: Fixed-capacity list where items know their own index (via BucketItem). O(1) add/remove by swapping with last element. Used for entity/component pools.

types.BucketItem: Interface for items in BucketList: getIndex/setIndex.
types.BucketItemPool<T extends BucketItem>: Object pool backed by BucketList with acquire/release semantics.
types.Flag: Bit flag abstraction: single named boolean flag with mask.
types.Flags: Collection of Flag instances with combined bitmask operations.

fastutil_wrappers.purpose: Custom wrappers around fastutil collections for specific hash strategies.

types.HLongOpenHashSet: Long open hash set with custom hash/comparison strategy.
types.HLongSet: Interface for the custom long set.
types.HObjectOpenHashSet<T>: Object open hash set with custom hash/comparison strategy.

DefaultMap<K,V>.purpose: Map wrapper that returns a default value for missing keys instead of null.

IWeightedElement.purpose: Interface for elements with a numeric weight (getWeight).

IWeightedMap<T>.purpose: Interface for weighted random selection from a collection.

WeightedMap<T extends IWeightedElement>.purpose: Implementation of weighted random selection. Tracks total weight. randomElement() picks proportionally. Supports add/remove/clear.

types.PluginIdentifier: Unique plugin ID with name and version.
types.PluginManifest: Full plugin manifest: identifier, description, author info, dependencies.

semver.purpose: Semantic versioning implementation for plugin dependency resolution.

Semver.purpose: Parses and represents a semantic version (major.minor.patch with optional pre-release and build metadata). Implements Comparable.

SemverComparator.purpose: Comparison operators for version constraints: GT, GTE, LT, LTE, EQ, NEQ.

SemverRange.purpose: Version range constraint (comparator + version). Supports satisfies(Semver) check.

SemverSatisfies.purpose: Collection of SemverRange constraints that must all be satisfied.

HytaleForkJoinThreadFactory.purpose: Custom ForkJoinPool thread factory with configurable thread name prefix and daemon flag.

Tickable.purpose: Interface for objects that update each game tick.

BoolDoublePair.purpose: Pair of boolean + double primitive values. Avoids boxing.

BoolIntPair.purpose: Pair of boolean + int primitive values. Avoids boxing.

utilities.ArrayUtil: Array operations: contains, indexOf, remove, toSet, flatten, copyOf, concat, with element manipulation for Object/int/double/boolean arrays.
utilities.BitSetUtil: BitSet operations: toIntArray, fromIntArray, intersects, union.
utilities.BitUtil: Bit manipulation: isPowerOf2, nextPowerOf2, countBits, highBit, lowBit.
utilities.CompletableFutureUtil: Utility for combining multiple CompletableFuture instances.
utilities.FormatUtil: String formatting: formatBytes, formatDuration, formatNumber, formatPercent, pad.
utilities.HardwareUtil: Hardware info: getProcessorCount, getTotalMemory, getFreeMemory, getMaxMemory, getCPUName.
utilities.ListUtil: List operations: unmodifiableAdd, unmodifiableRemove, combine, randomElement.
utilities.MapUtil: Map operations: merge, invert, computeIfAbsent variants.
utilities.ManifestUtil: JAR manifest reading utility (in java subpackage).
utilities.PathUtil: Path string manipulation: normalizeAssetPath, getExtension, removeExtension.
utilities.PatternUtil: Regex pattern helpers: globToRegex, compile with caching.
utilities.RandomUtil: Random utilities: nextGaussian(mean, stddev), nextBetween(min, max).

events.description: Two independent event hierarchies — standard EventBus events (IEvent/IAsyncEvent) and ECS events (EcsEvent). They share no base class and use completely different dispatch mechanisms.

standardEvents.description: Traditional observer-pattern event bus. Events are dispatched through EventBus, registered via IEventRegistry. Supports keyed dispatch, priority ordering, sync/async, global/unhandled listeners.

IEventBus.description: Central event bus interface. dispatch() is a convenience for dispatchFor(class, null).dispatch(null). The dispatchFor/dispatchForAsync pattern returns a reusable dispatcher object.

dispatchFlow.sync: dispatchFor(class, key) -> SyncEventBusRegistry.dispatchFor(key) -> SyncEventConsumerMap.dispatch(event) -> iterate priority-sorted consumers -> call global -> call unhandled if no keyed listeners handled it
dispatchFlow.async: dispatchForAsync(class, key) -> AsyncEventBusRegistry.dispatchFor(key) -> AsyncEventConsumerMap.dispatch(event) -> CompletableFuture chain through priority-sorted functions -> global -> unhandled

command_patterns.self_and_other_variant: Many player commands (gamemode, give) use addUsageVariant() for a variant that takes an additional player argument. The self-version extends AbstractPlayerCommand; the other-variant extends CommandBase with explicit permission (.other suffix).
command_patterns.subcommand_collection: Collections (EntityCommand, PlayerCommand, ChunkCommand) extend AbstractCommandCollection and register subcommands in constructor via addSubCommand().
command_patterns.stats_pattern: Both player and entity stats use the same sub-structure: Add, Dump, Get, Reset, Set, SetToMax subcommands.

other_system_types.Tokenizer: Splits command string into tokens. Handles quotes, brackets for lists, commas as list separators, escape sequences.
other_system_types.ParserContext: Separates tokens into pre-optional positional tokens, list tokens, and optional --named args. Tracks subcommand depth.
other_system_types.MatchResult: Comparable search result for command fuzzy matching. Ranked by: term priority, match type (NAME=0, ALIAS=1, USAGE_ARG=3, DESCRIPTION=4, USAGE_DESCRIPTION=5), depth, Levenshtein distance.
other_system_types.AbbreviationMap<V>: Prefix-based lookup map for optional argument abbreviation. Builds all prefixes; nulls out ambiguous abbreviations.
other_system_types.CommandValidationResults: Bridges codec validation framework to command ParseResult.

codecs.overview: Type-safe serialization/deserialization framework for Hytale's asset data. Codecs define how Java objects are encoded to/decoded from BSON/JSON. The core abstraction is the Codec<T> interface; the primary implementation is BuilderCodec<T> which uses a fluent builder pattern to define field mappings. Supports inheritance, versioning, validation, and JSON schema generation.

Codec<T>.description: Core interface. decode(BsonValue, ExtraInfo) -> T and encode(T, ExtraInfo) -> BsonValue. Also extends RawJsonCodec<T> for direct JSON parsing and SchemaConvertable<T> for schema generation.
static_instances: BYTE_ARRAY, DOUBLE_ARRAY, FLOAT_ARRAY, INT_ARRAY, LONG_ARRAY, STRING_ARRAY

core_interfaces.RawJsonCodec<T>: Interface for direct JSON stream parsing: decodeJson(RawJsonReader, ExtraInfo) -> T.
core_interfaces.RawJsonInheritCodec<T>: Extends RawJsonCodec with inheritance-aware JSON parsing: decodeAndInheritJson(reader, parent, extraInfo).
core_interfaces.DirectDecodeCodec<T>: Extends Codec with in-place decode: decode(BsonValue, T existing, ExtraInfo). Used by BuilderCodec to decode into existing objects.
core_interfaces.InheritCodec<T>: Extends Codec with inheritance: decodeAndInherit(BsonDocument, T parent, ExtraInfo). BuilderCodec implements this for parent-child asset inheritance.
core_interfaces.PrimitiveCodec: Marker interface for primitive codecs (boolean, int, etc.). Triggers null-check enforcement.
core_interfaces.WrappedCodec<T>: Interface for codecs that wrap another: getChildCodec().

BuilderCodec<T>.description: The primary codec implementation. Defines object serialization via named fields, each mapped by a KeyedCodec. Supports parent codec inheritance, versioning, afterDecode hooks, and validation.
key_fields: supplier: Supplier<T> — creates new instances (null for abstract codecs)
parentCodec: BuilderCodec<? super T> — for inheritance chains
entries: Map<String, List<BuilderField<T,?>>> — field definitions keyed by JSON key name
stringTreeMap: StringTreeMap — optimized key lookup for JSON parsing
builder_api: BuilderCodec.builder(Class<T>, Supplier<T>, BuilderCodec<? super T> parent) — with parent
decode_flow: 2. If versioned, read 'Version' field and create VersionedExtraInfo
3. For each JSON key, look up BuilderField via StringTreeMap (O(key-length) lookup)
4. Each field: decode via its KeyedCodec, run validators, call setter
inheritance_flow: 2. inherit(t, parent, extraInfo) — copies all field values from parent
3. Decode JSON fields, overriding inherited values
4. For nested BuilderCodec fields, recursively inherit with field-level parent values
BuilderCodec<T>.schema_generation: toSchema() produces ObjectSchema with all fields. Versioned codecs include Version property. Comments ($Title, $Comment, etc.) are included. Each field schema includes type, nullability, validation constraints, documentation, and metadata.

BuilderField<Type, FieldType>.description: Represents a single field in a BuilderCodec. Holds KeyedCodec, setter/getter lambdas, optional inherit function, validators, metadata, version range.
key_features: Version range (minVersion/maxVersion) — fields active only for specific codec versions
Validators: List<Validator<? super FieldType>> — run on decode
NonNullValidator detection — triggers post-decode null check

StringTreeMap<V>.description: Trie-like data structure for O(key-length) key matching against a RawJsonReader stream. Avoids string allocation during JSON parsing.

KeyedCodec<T>.description: Associates a string key with a Codec<T>. Enforces PascalCase key naming (first char uppercase). Provides get/getOrNull/getNow/put operations on BsonDocument.
KeyedCodec<T>.key_constraint: Keys must start with uppercase letter. Used as JSON/BSON field names.
KeyedCodec<T>.required_flag: Optional 'required' flag; when false, null BsonValues return null.

array_codecs.ArrayCodec<T>: Generic array codec wrapping an element Codec<T> and array constructor

collection_codecs.SetCodec<T>: Codec for Set<T> backed by ObjectOpenHashSet
collection_codecs.MapCodec<K,V>: Codec for Map<K,V> using string keys
collection_codecs.MergedEnumMapCodec<K,V>: EnumMap that merges with parent during inheritance

function_codecs.FunctionCodec<T,R>: Wraps a Codec<T> with decode/encode Function transforms. E.g., String -> Path, String -> UUID.
function_codecs.BsonFunctionCodec<T>: Like FunctionCodec but operates on BsonValue level with BiFunction.

special_codecs.EnumCodec<E>: Codec for enums by name string
special_codecs.UUIDBinaryCodec: Codec for UUID stored as binary BSON
special_codecs.StringIntegerCodec: Codec for integer stored as string in JSON
special_codecs.DocumentContainingCodec<T>: BuilderCodec wrapper that captures extra (unknown) fields into a BsonDocument property

codec_map_lookup.overview: CodecMap system for polymorphic deserialization — selecting the correct codec based on a type discriminator key.

types.ACodecMapCodec<T>: Abstract base. Has codec map (string key -> Codec<T>).
types.CodecMapCodec<T>: Uses a KeyedCodec to read the type key, then dispatches to the matching codec.
types.StringCodecMapCodec<T>: Codec map keyed by plain strings.
types.ObjectCodecMapCodec<T>: Codec map keyed by arbitrary objects.
types.MapKeyMapCodec<T>: Uses the first map key as the codec discriminator.
types.AMapProvidedMapCodec<T>: Abstract base for codecs where the type codec comes from an AssetMap.
types.MapProvidedMapCodec<T>: Concrete implementation resolving codec from an AssetMap lookup.
types.Priority: Enum for codec registration priority ordering.

serialization.bson_path: Codec.decode(BsonValue, ExtraInfo) -> T. BuilderCodec iterates BsonDocument entries, matches keys to BuilderFields, decodes each.
serialization.json_path: Codec.decodeJson(RawJsonReader, ExtraInfo) -> T. BuilderCodec uses StringTreeMap for O(1) key lookup per character. Direct stream parsing avoids intermediate BsonDocument.
serialization.encode_path: Codec.encode(T, ExtraInfo) -> BsonValue. BuilderCodec creates BsonDocument, iterates fields, encodes non-null values.
serialization.RawJsonReader: Streaming JSON parser. Supports mark/reset, peek, string consumption, null/int/float/boolean reading, value skipping. Used for efficient direct JSON decode.

inheritance_system.description: BuilderCodec supports parent-child asset inheritance. A child JSON file specifies a 'Parent' key. During decode, the parent object is first inherited (all fields copied), then the child's JSON overrides specific fields.
inheritance_system.InheritCodec_interface: decodeAndInherit(BsonDocument, T parent, ExtraInfo) and decodeAndInheritJson(reader, T parent, ExtraInfo). BuilderCodec implements both.
inheritance_system.field_level_inheritance: For nested BuilderCodec fields, inheritance is recursive — the field's parent value is passed down.
inheritance_system.custom_inherit: Fields can define custom inherit functions via appendInherited() for special merge logic (e.g., MergedEnumMapCodec).

validation_system.Validator<T>: Functional interface: accept(T, ValidationResults). Can also modify Schema.
validation_system.ValidatableCodec<T>: Interface: validate(T, ExtraInfo) and validateDefaults(ExtraInfo, Set<Codec<?>>).
validation_system.ValidationResults: Accumulates validation errors. Has _processValidationResults() to flush.
validation_system.ThrowingValidationResults: Throws on validation failure (used in default ExtraInfo).
validation_system.Validators: Factory methods: nonNull(), greaterThan(), range(), etc.
concrete_validators: NonNullValidator — field must not be null
OrValidator — combines validators with OR logic

schema_generation.SchemaContext: Context for schema generation, providing refDefinition() for $ref-style definitions.
schema_generation.NamedSchema: Schema with a name for $ref generation.
schema_generation.Schema: Base schema class. Has type, description, title, HytaleType metadata.
concrete_schemas: ObjectSchema — JSON object with properties, additionalProperties
StringSchema — JSON string with pattern, enum values

metadata_annotations.HytaleType: Core metadata: inheritsProperty, mergesProperties, deprecated, etc.
metadata_annotations.AllowEmptyObject: Marks an object schema as accepting {}
metadata_annotations.UI annotations: UIButton, UICreateButtons, UIDefaultCollapsedState, UIDisplayMode, UIEditor, UIEditorFeatures, UIEditorPreview, UIEditorSectionStart, UIPropertyTitle, UIRebuildCaches, UISidebarButtons, UITypeIcon — all for Hytale's content editor UI

Documentation_annotation.Documentation: Utility for generating documentation strings from codec structures.

codec_store.CodecStore: Named codec registry with parent chain. Static singleton + per-context stores. Stores codecs by CodecKey<T>. Supports lazy suppliers.
codec_store.CodecKey<T>: Typed key with string ID for CodecStore lookup.
codec_store.StoredCodec<T>: Implements Codec<T> by delegating to a codec looked up from ExtraInfo.getCodecStore() at decode time. Enables late-bound codec resolution.

versioning.description: BuilderCodec supports versioned schemas. When versioned=true, a 'Version' int field is read first. Each BuilderField has a version range [minVersion, maxVersion]. During decode, only fields matching the document version are active.
versioning.VersionedExtraInfo: Decorator on ExtraInfo that carries the decoded version number.
versioning.legacy_version: Deprecated path where version comes from ExtraInfo.getLegacyVersion() instead of the document.

exception_handling.CodecException: Main exception for codec decode/encode failures. Carries context: ExtraInfo key path, source BsonValue/reader, cause.
